The race is a celebration for lovers of the mountains and adventure, attracting runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The organizers emphasize the safety and support of participants throughout the race.

description: The 1st Nafpaktos Half Marathon “Ahepa Run” is a new road race that combines sport with Greece’s cultural heritage. The race routes pass through historic paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience for all runners. The event also includes a 1 km race for children and a 5 km race for amateur runners and people with disabilities, promoting social connection and sustainable tourism. Participants receive full support, electronic timing, and commemorative gifts.
course_highlights: Routes through ancient paths and natural landscapes
5 hydration stations with water and energy drinks
Electronic timing and medical support throughout
additional: Participant amenities: race bib, backpack, commemorative T-shirt, finisher’s medal, electronic certificate, medical support, bag-drop and changing facilities, athlete transportation, 5 hydration stations, electronic timing, and refreshments along the course and at the finish. The event includes a half marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1 km children’s race, with impressive routes through natural and historic landscapes. Participation promotes health and the area’s cultural identity.

name: Gidi of Methana
description: The Methana GOAT is an annual mountain running race held in autumn on the volcanic peninsula of Methana. It offers courses of 28 km with 1,720 m of elevation gain, 12 km with 680 m, and 5 km with 120 m, attracting athletes seeking a challenge across rugged volcanic terrain. The race stands out for its constantly changing scenery, views of the sea from high points, and warm hospitality. The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race.
course_highlights: Volcanic terrain with steep climbs
Frequent views of the sea from high mountain passes
Beautiful landscapes with changing natural surroundings
additional: Courses: 28 km (+1,720 m), 12 km (+680 m), and 5 km (+120 m). The area’s thermal baths offer a chance to relax before or after the race. Trail race through volcanic landscapes in Methana, Greece; registration via the official website; scheduled for November 22–23, 2025.

description: The International Olympia Marathon is a historic road race held in Ancient Olympia, the birthplace of Olympism. Runners have the opportunity to run along the historic “Sacred Way,” following a route rich in cultural memory and sporting ideals. The event includes a Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km, Family Run, and children’s race, offering a unique sporting experience for everyone. The start and finish are at the Town Hall Square in Ancient Olympia, with full support and services for participants.
course_highlights: Route along the historic “Sacred Way” of Ancient Olympia
8 support stations with water, isotonic drinks, energy gels, and medical assistance
Kilometre markers every 5 km and electronic timing
additional: Runner benefits: race bib with electronic timing chip, commemorative medal and T-shirt, and water, isotonic drink, energy drink, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. There are 8 support stations with water, isotonic drink, and energy gels. A medical check is mandatory to participate. Doping control is conducted by the Hellenic Anti-Doping Organization. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the Ancient Olympia Town Hall, as well as portable toilets along the course. Runners must keep to the right side of the road. The event welcomes participants from around the world and features celebrations and awards, with an emphasis on cultural heritage and the spirit of the Olympic Games.

name: Πεντελικόν Μάραθων
description: The Pentelikon Marathon is a 12-kilometer mountain race, organized for the fourth consecutive year by the Telmissos Nea Makri Marathon Runners’ Association in collaboration with the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association. The route follows forest trails, starting at Agia Marina in Nea Makri. The race aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service to the community. Despite recent fire damage, Mount Pentelikon retains its remarkable beauty and historical significance, and the race contributes to efforts to restore the mountains.
course_highlights: A 12 km mountain route on forest trails
Start at Agia Marina in Nea Makri
An area of great historical significance and natural beauty
additional: The race is organized with the support of the Municipality of Marathon and under the auspices of EOSLMA-Y. The start is at 10:00 a.m. The event aims to provide financial support to the Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association for forest protection and volunteer service. The route passes by S.E.D.M. (Marathon Volunteer Forest Firefighters Association) and follows a trail through a forest that suffered a fire in August 2024. The event includes competitive and volunteer participation, with an emphasis on enjoying nature and promoting mountain running.

name: 6ο Κέρη Cross Country Race
description: The Keri Cross Country Race offers two routes through the Keri Forest in Heraklion, Crete: one 10.2 kilometers long and one 5 kilometers long. The 10.2 km route is fast in the first half but challenging, with uphill elevation in the second half, making it ideal for experienced runners. The 5 km route is shorter and faster, suitable for beginners or those who prefer an easier trail route. The race is held every December and offers a beautiful challenge for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Keri Forest, known for its natural beauty
Fast and challenging 10.2 km route with uphill elevation
Easy, fast 5 km route suitable for beginners
additional: There is an award for the fastest team, based on the average time of the 6 fastest athletes (3 men and 3 women), awarded separately for the 5 km and 10 km routes. The race includes 5 km and 10.2 km routes, with participants across various age categories and genders. The organizers also provide information about rules and registration, and the location is known for its natural surroundings and beauty.

description: The 27th Daphni Grove Race is a traditional 10-kilometer road race held in Daphni Grove. The course starts on Athens Avenue and passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite, offering a route away from the city noise with beautiful views of the Thriasian Gulf. The race is dedicated to the memory of Babis Georgats zonas and is a celebration for runners, with traditional hospitality and electronic timing. Participants are asked to arrive early to collect their race numbers, and there is a place to store their belongings.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometer course in Daphni Grove
Passes beside the ancient sanctuary of Daphni Apollo and Aphaia Aphrodite
Views of the Thriasian Gulf, away from the city noise
additional: The start is on Athens Avenue, near Daphni Hospital. Athletes must arrive at least one hour before the start to collect their race numbers from the registration desk. Electronic timing and baggage storage are available. It is recommended that participants leave their cars at the end of Iera Odos, near Daphni Monastery, to avoid congestion. Electronic timing and baggage storage are provided. Race-number pickup takes place before the start; arriving at least one hour early is recommended.

The event takes place in central Aegina and combines sport with cultural heritage, attracting a large number of participants each year. The longer-distance races start in the morning, while the shorter races start earlier, creating a wonderful sporting atmosphere for the whole family.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup is a popular series of winter trail races in the mountains of Attica, offering runners of all levels the chance to enjoy mountain running and nature. The event includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, more technical course and a shorter one for beginners. The series has become an established fixture in the running community and offers incentives through awards, prize draws and individual and team rankings. MyRace is responsible for organizing the event, with support from Salomon, which invites runners of all ages to take part in this celebration of mountain running.
course_highlights: Three races in the mountains of Attica: Penteli, Hymettus and Parnitha
Two courses at each race: a long course (10–12 km) and a short course (4–7 km), both with significant elevation gain
Natural scenery and technical trails, with elevation gains ranging from +170 m to +660 m
additional: At each race, the top three men and women in each distance receive awards. Age categories are available only for the long distance. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Four pairs of Salomon shoes are drawn at each race. There are individual and team rankings for the long distance. Teams consist of 3 people, and the top three teams receive awards. In a recent edition, the race in Penteli started from Semelis Square. The event provided a race number with a timing chip, water stations, snacks at the finish, a commemorative certificate and medical coverage.

The race offers two routes: the longer Retzaka Challenge, 24.7 km with significant elevation gain, and the shorter Retzaka Entry, 6.8 km, ideal for those who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and Retzaka Waterfall. The event stands out for its route through villages and natural landscapes, offering a unique mountain-running experience. The races start in the morning, with the Challenge starting at 10:00 and the shorter route at 10:30.

name: 5ο Sparta City Ultra
description: The running club “Spartans Runners” is organizing the 5th Sparta City Ultra in Sparta, Laconia, on Saturday, February 7 and Sunday, February 8, 2026. The event includes three races lasting 6, 12 and 24 hours, with an intermediate time point at 100 miles. The course is an 822-meter loop, starting and finishing near the statue of King Leonidas and the Sparta Municipal Stadium. The winners are those who cover the greatest distance within their race’s time limit.
course_highlights: An 822-meter loop along Konstantinou Palaiologou Avenue
Start and finish near the statue of King Leonidas and the Sparta Municipal Stadium
6-, 12- and 24-hour races, with an intermediate time point at 100 miles
additional: A central aid station provides water, electrolytes, coffee/tea, soft drinks, fruit, nuts and snacks. Hot food (pasta and soup) is provided depending on the race duration. Organized bus transportation is available from Athens (Karaiskaki Square, Metaxourgeio), with specific departure and return times for each race. Race-pack pickup takes place on Saturday and Sunday before the race. Awards are presented to the top 6 men and women in each race, and all finishers receive a medal and a T-shirt. The event includes multiple race categories, aid stations with food and drinks, transportation options from Athens, and registration through the Athletin platform.

The race is an alternative sporting get-together with a strong local character and tradition.

The first 100 participants receive a free T-shirt, and prizes are awarded to top finishers in various categories. The event promotes participation in sport and social solidarity.

Free entry for students, members of sports clubs, and people with disabilities
Prizes for the top finishers in the men’s, women’s, children’s, and disability categories

The course is paved, completely flat, and loops around the rowing course, offering an enjoyable and fast experience. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km races, with technical support provided by MyRace.

description: The sporting spectacle in Orchomenos, Boeotia, on Sunday, February 15, 2026, combines the 10th anniversary MaskaRun with the 1st “Asopichos” 5 km race and events for Panhellenic Sports Fans Day. The event is a major celebration of sport, remembrance, and humanity, with free participation for everyone. Orchomenos Central Square will be the hub of the events, which will also include a handball demonstration and prize draws for children. MaskaRun has become an established event with mass participation, and this year a certified “Asopichos” 5 km race course with official timing is being added.

name: 11ο Lycabettus Run
description: The 11th Lycabettus Run is a unique road race held on the lush Lycabettus Hill in Athens. The courses include paved and dirt roads, offering a one-of-a-kind running experience surrounded by nature and overlooking the city. The race includes individual and team categories, with morning starts and full support for runners. The event offers medals, cups, digital certificates, medical coverage, and aid stations.

name: 11ος Αγώνας Δρόμου “Η καρδιά του παιδιού”
description: The 11th “The Child’s Heart” Road Race takes place as part of World Congenital Heart Defect Awareness Day and offers two routes of 7 and 10.5 kilometers through the lush, beautiful natural landscape of Fodele, Heraklion, Crete. The race aims to raise awareness and support children with heart conditions, while also offering a great sporting experience for runners of all levels. The event bears the name of and is supported by the Association for the Protection, Information and Assistance of Children with Heart Conditions “The Child’s Heart.”

name: Προπονητική Ημερίδα Νίκης Βύρωνα
description: The Niki Vyronas Training Meet is organized by the Niki Vyronas Gymnastics Club, based at the Vyronas Municipal Stadium. Founded in 2005, the club offers specialized guidance from coaches with experience and high athletic achievements. The meet aims to promote track and field and improve quality of life through exercise. It offers athletes and sports enthusiasts an opportunity to discover the joy of athletics in a friendly, well-organized setting.

name: Salomon Mountain Cup
description: The Salomon Mountain Cup 2026 is a popular winter trail-race series in the mountains of Attica, offering new racing experiences for runners of all levels. It includes three races in Penteli, Hymettus, and Parnitha, with two courses at each race: a longer, technical, and challenging course, and a shorter one for beginners or training. The event aims to connect runners with nature and showcase the beauty of mountain running in Attica. MyRace is responsible for organizing the series, with Salomon supporting it as title sponsor.

description: The 5th Friendship and Solidarity Memorial Run is a special sporting event held in the former forest of Varympompi. The money collected from runners who do not show up will be donated to an orphanage. There is no electronic timing or awards, as all participants are considered winners and receive a mug as a keepsake.

description: The 10th Road of Values, organized by the 1st Argos Scout Group, is a running race dedicated to the universal values of life. The race is held on February 22, on the occasion of Scout Thinking Day, and honors the memory of the great Greek marathon runner Stelios Kyriakides. The start and finish are at Kefalari, Argos, at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi, offering a special experience for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 10 km road race starting and finishing at Kefalari, Argos
650-meter children's race at the same location
Special tribute to Stelios Kyriakides and universal values
additional: The event includes two simultaneous starts at 10:30 a.m. for the main 10 km race and the 650-meter children's race. The event has a long tradition and is associated with Scout Thinking Day. The race is dedicated to universal values and takes place in a natural setting, starting and finishing at the Church of Zoodochos Pigi. Participation is free and includes a 650-meter children's race.

name: Γεντίκι Trail 9
description: The Gentiki Trail is a mountain race held in the Gentiki area of Larissa. The 21-kilometer course follows marked trails, with a positive elevation gain of +1370 meters, offering a demanding and exciting experience for mountain runners. There is also a shorter 5.1-kilometer course with a positive elevation gain of +250 meters, ideal for those looking for a shorter challenge. The race serves as a qualifying event for participation in the Olympus Marathon, attracting runners seeking a high level of competition and natural beauty.

name: 5ο Koumaria Trail Series
description: The 5th Koumaria Trail Series is organized by the Achaia Marathon Runners’ Association “Pheidippides” and offers a challenging off-road course through the mountainous natural surroundings of Petrotó, Achaia. The event includes 40 km, 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km routes, with many runners and volunteers, offering a unique mountain-running experience. The race is marked by strong competition, as well as support and assistance for runners at aid stations. The event honors tradition and the beauty of nature while promoting sport and well-being.
course_highlights: Challenging off-road mountain terrain
40 km, 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km routes
Aid stations in the mountain village of Petrotó
additional: The Achaia Marathon Runners’ Association “Pheidippides” operates aid stations and assists approximately 600 mountain runners with the help of volunteers. The race is a major organizational success and also honors athletes with personal records. Technical off-road terrain, participation and volunteer involvement, major organizational success, and support activities.

name: 2ο Τρέχω Στον Μαραθώνα
description: The “MARATHON - I Run in Marathon” road race is a flat 6.8-kilometer race held in Nea Makri, by the sea, along the Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade. It is aimed at experienced runners and athletes over the age of 15, offering an enjoyable route without difficulties. The start and finish are at the central small harbor of Nea Makri, with the race starting at 16:30. The event provides hydration and snack stations along the route and at the finish, ensuring a complete experience for participants.
course_highlights: Flat 6.8 km route by the sea
Nea Makri–Marathon Beach coastal promenade
Start and finish at the central small harbor of Nea Makri
additional: The entry package includes hydration and snacks along the route and at the finish. Stations provide bottled water, soft drinks, juices, bananas, sweet snacks, and savory snacks. Participation is open to people over the age of 15, with parental consent required for minors under 18. Runners participate at their own risk and must have recent medical examinations. Routes of approximately 8.2 km, participation open to all ages, online registration, finish at the port of Nea Makri, with water and snacks provided during and after the race.

name: 18ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Καθαράς Δευτέρας
location: Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Saviour, Alepochori, Attica, Greece
description: The 18th Clean Monday Road Race is a traditional 10,000-meter race held in Alepochori, Attica, starting and finishing at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior. The course is uneven, dirt, and marked, offering a beautiful experience for runners of all levels. There is also a 300-meter children’s race and a carnival costume and dance contest. After the race, a celebration follows with music, wine, and traditional Lenten dishes, creating a festive atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Uneven dirt course
Start and finish at the Byzantine Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Savior
Marked course and water provided
additional: The 10,000-meter race is limited to 250 athletes. Registration is by telephone only. A bus is available for €10, departing from Metaxourgeio (Karaiskaki Square) at 8:00. After the race, participants receive a handmade commemorative medal; trophies and prizes are awarded for the children’s race and costume contest. The post-race celebration features a DJ, dancing, wine, and a picnic with traditional Lenten dishes. For the 18th edition, the limit is stated as 250 participants in the 10 km race, with telephone registration. A bus from Athens is available for a €10 fare. description: The 2nd Historic Trail Elateia is a mountain race offering three routes of varying distances and difficulty, set in a beautiful natural and historic environment. The route starts from Elateia’s central square and follows trails and forest roads, passing archaeological sites and offering unique views of the Maliakos Gulf and the surrounding mountains. The race is also suitable for runners with limited experience in mountain running, with full course marking and aid stations. The event is renowned for its excellent organization, support from volunteers, and participation by the local community.

The race is open to athletes aged 12 and over, with special requirements for minors. It is organized by the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros and SMF SPORTS, which is responsible for organizing and supporting the event.

Panoramic views of the Thermaic Gulf and the Pierian Mountains
500-metre children’s race for younger athletes

description: The 6th Mani Loop is an 80.5-kilometer ultramarathon held in the Mesa Mani region, starting and finishing in Areopoli. The route makes a complete loop of Mesa Mani and runs entirely on paved roads. The race has historical significance, taking place near March 17, the day the 1821 Revolution began in Mani. This year, it is dedicated to the Battle of Diros and the Maniot woman. It is intended for runners who have completed a marathon or ultramarathon in the past two years, and has a 12-hour time limit.

name: DRC x URC Run
description: DRC X URC Run is a friendly running event in central Athens, offering a chance to enjoy a light run and socialize with other runners. The route offers 5 km and 8 km options, with different paces to suit each participant. The run starts at the Karaiskakis Statue in the Zappeion, creating a lovely atmosphere for a running morning. Participation is free and limited to 200 places, so runners are encouraged to sign up quickly.

The race offers an enjoyable experience for all participants, with amenities including a T-shirt, medal, and commemorative certificate. The race starts at 11:30 a.m. Participation is open to women over 18, and minors may participate with parental consent.

name: 1ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ηγουμενίτσας
description: The 1st Igoumenitsa Road Race (Igoumenitsa City Run) is organized by the Igoumenitsa Runners’ Association in collaboration with the sports company Epirus Athletic Events and the Municipality of Igoumenitsa. The event features 10,000m and 5,000m races, as well as a 1,000m children’s race for primary school students. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center, offering a unique experience on a beautiful urban route. The race is dedicated to the memory of young Maximos Lamprousis, honoring his memory and smile.
course_highlights: 10,000m and 5,000m routes through the city of Igoumenitsa
A 1,000m children’s race for primary school students
Start and finish at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:35 a.m. The race is dedicated to the memory of Maximos Lamprousis. The start and finish are at the Pantheon Municipal Cultural Center. Organized in the coastal zone, with participation open to all ages and levels, plus a celebration and surprises in the city.

name: 4ος Καλλιγώνιος Ημιμαραθώνιος
description: The Kalligonios Half Marathon in Lefkada is an annual road race offering events for everyone, from a children’s race to a half marathon. The race combines an athletic challenge with the beauty of Lefkada’s scenery, attracting runners of all ages and abilities. The event is friendly and offers all participants an enjoyable experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km and 9 km routes featuring natural scenery and historical monuments
1,000 m race for Special Olympics participants and children
Discounts on accommodation and transport for participants
additional: An event focused on cultural and athletic experiences, with entries in various categories and preparation for other races. Registration for 2027 appears to be opening soon.

name: 5ο Coast To Coast Race
location: Παραλία Παχιάς Άμμου, Ιεράπετρα, Λασίθι, Κρήτη, Ελλάδα
description: The Coast to Coast Race in Ierapetra, Crete, is a 21,100-meter half marathon that starts at Pachia Ammos Beach and finishes at Minos Square in Ierapetra. The route crosses the narrowest part of Crete, passing through picturesque villages and the Ha Gorge, while the final kilometers offer an introduction to the city’s most important sights. A 5,000-meter race and a 1,000-meter children’s race are also held, offering a complete sporting experience for everyone. The race has a cultural and tourism focus and is organized by the Ierapetra Runners’ Club.
course_highlights: Route from Pachia Ammos Beach to Minos Square in Ierapetra
Passes through Ha Gorge and the villages of Episkopi, Pano Chorio, Kato Chorio, and Kentri
Finish with views of the South Cretan Sea (Libyan Sea) and an introduction to Ierapetra’s sights
additional: Half-marathon participants are transported by buses organized by the event from Minos Square until 8:00 a.m. The 5,000-meter race and the 5,000-meter Health Run and Power Walking event start and finish at Minos Square in Ierapetra. There is also a 1,000-meter children’s race. The event includes running races and walking, with routes through a scenic area and preparatory events. Participants can enjoy Crete’s beautiful nature and welcoming atmosphere.

name: Τρέχω για την άνοιξη ζωής
organizer: Πανελλήνια Ένωση Γονέων και Κηδεμόνων Ατόμων Παιδιών Νοητικά Υστερούντων (ΠΕΓΚΑΠ - ΝΥ)
description: The “I Run for the Spring of Life” road race is held under the auspices of the Attica Region and with the support of the Friends’ Association of P.E.G.K.A.P.-N.Y. It is a sporting event featuring 10 km and 4 km races, as well as a 500 m race for people with disabilities. The races start and finish on Drosias Avenue in Stamata. The courses are looped and pass by notable landmarks in the Municipality of Dionysos, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all levels. The event is open to runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes, with categories by age and gender.
course_highlights: Looped 10 km course (2 × 5 km), starting and finishing on Drosias Avenue in Stamata
4 km course for middle-school boys and girls and adults
500 m race open to people with disabilities
additional: The races take place on Sunday, March 28, 2027, in the Municipality of Dionysos. There are age categories for men and women, with age limits and veterans’ categories. Runners who train regularly as well as amateur athletes are eligible to participate. The start and finish are at the corner of Drosias–Stamata Avenue and Solomou Street, with designated turnarounds on the 2.5 km and 2 km courses. All participation supports charitable causes, with an emphasis on strengthening social cohesion and raising awareness about people with disabilities.

name: Voio Race – Νεάπολη
description: The Voio Race in Neapoli is organized by the Municipality of Voio and includes 10,000 m and 5,000 m races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race. The start and finish are on Neapoli’s pedestrian street, and the course runs along the old Tsotyli–Neapoli national road. The race is open to runners aged 12 and over, offering a pleasant experience on a public road with support from the local traffic police. The event uses wave starts and provides electronic timing for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course on a public road, starting from the Tsotyli Health Center
5 km course, starting from the junction in the village of Peristera
1 km children’s race, starting from the kiosk at the entrance to Neapoli
additional: Participants collect a race number with an integrated timing chip and race materials from the registration center on race day. The 22 km race has a maximum finish time of 4 hours and uses wave starts, with runners assigned to start blocks based on their times. After the time limit, runners who have not finished continue at their own risk on the sidewalk. The event includes courses on public roads and pedestrian streets, with support from volunteers and awards for the winners. The event takes place on 28 March 2027.

name: 4ο Serres Circuit Run
description: The 4th Serres Circuit Run is a major running event returning to Serres, offering a unique experience for runners of all levels. The race takes place at the Serres Autodrome, a specially designed venue that combines safety with an exciting course. The event is supported by the Municipality of Serres, with the aim of promoting sports and the local community. It brings runners and spectators together in a friendly, vibrant atmosphere.

name: 9ο “Το Δεκάρι του Πάρκου”
description: The 9th Charity Road Race “The Park 10K” is being held for the ninth consecutive year on the beautiful trails of Tritsis Park. This is a cross-country race with 5- and 10-kilometer courses, supported by the Metropolitan Park Management Agency and organized for charity, benefiting MDA Hellas. The race attracts runners of all ages and abilities who enjoy running in nature and supporting their community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at the Antonis Tritsis Environmental Awareness Park
5- and 10-kilometer courses through a natural setting
Access through five main entrances, with Entrance A recommended as it is near the start
additional: Tritsis Park can be accessed through five entrances; Entrance A, near the start, is recommended. The race is supported by the Park Management Agency and benefits MDA Hellas. It promotes social awareness, the protection of Tritsis Park, and support for MDA Hellas, while offering people of all ages the chance to enjoy sports in a natural setting.

name: 9ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σπερχειού
description: The 9th Spercheios Half Marathon “Athanasios Akridas” is held in Spercheiada, in the regional unit of Phthiotis, with the support of the Municipality of Makrakomi and the Spercheiada Municipal Community. This road race celebrates the area’s traditions and natural beauty, offering a unique experience for runners who love running and nature. The event is a celebration of sport and social responsibility, aiming to promote sport for all and encourage volunteering.

The race offers runners of all ages an opportunity to take part in a route through a beautiful suburb with sports and cultural facilities. The event is supported by the Municipality of Filothei-Psychiko and promotes physical activity and social solidarity in the local community. The city is counting down to Sunday, March 22, race day.

name: 2ο DUTH Campus Half Marathon
organizer: Δημοκρίτειο Πανεπιστήμιο Θράκης και Περιφερειακή Ενότητα Ροδόπης
description: The DUTH Campus Half Marathon is being held for the third consecutive year at the Democritus University of Thrace campus in Komotini. It features two distances, 7,000 meters and 21,000 meters, on a smooth, flat dirt course within the university campus. Entry is free, and electronic timing is provided, along with a commemorative medal for all finishers. In addition, the top three finishers in each race and age category receive trophies. The race starts at 10:30 a.m., with the start and finish at the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science.
course_highlights: Smooth, flat dirt course within the DUTH campus
Two distances: 7,000 m and 21,000 m
Start and finish at the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science
additional: Entry is free. Electronic timing and overall and individual results are provided. All finishers receive a commemorative collectible medal. Trophies are awarded to the top three finishers in each race and age category. A medical examination is required for all athletes and for the parents or guardians of underage athletes. The event is held with the support of the DUTH Department of Physical Education and Sport Science, with commemorative medals, trophies, and family activities. The course is flat and suitable for all runners.

name: 2ο Vertical Challenge
description: The 2nd Vertical Challenge is an international “vertical kilometer” mountain running race held in Gerakas, Xanthi, organized by the Xanthi Mountaineering Club in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi. Athletes start in the village of Gerakas and follow a 3.5 km uphill route with 1,000 m of elevation gain, finishing at an altitude of 1,415 m. The Gerakas Trail and Gerakas Path races are also held, featuring circular routes of varying difficulty and distance. The event welcomes runners aged 12 and over, with special requirements for younger participants. Registration is individual and takes place online through the club’s website.
course_highlights: Vertical Challenge: 3.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain on trails, finishing at an altitude of 1,415 m
Gerakas Trail: circular 8.5 km route with 1,000 m of elevation gain
Gerakas Path: easy circular 5 km route with 240 m of elevation gain
additional: Maximum number of participants in the 2nd Vertical Challenge: 80. ITRA score must be provided if available. Individual registrations only. Open to participants aged 12 and over, with special requirements for ages 16–18. Organized in collaboration with the Regional Unit of Xanthi, with limited places and registration through the website.

name: 3ος Παράκτιος Ημιμαραθώνιος Θερμαϊκού Αντώνης Ματζάρης
description: The Thermaikos Coastal Half Marathon “Antonis Matzaris” is a distinctive running event in eastern Thessaloniki, offering unique routes along the coastline of the Municipality of Thermaikos. Held on a fixed date and attracting large numbers of runners, the race combines sport and social action, drawing families and runners of all levels. The event aims to establish itself as an important sporting occasion with a quality focus and a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: A coastal route of unique beauty
Routes suitable for the whole family
Impressive performances and runner participation
additional: A limited number of new registrations are available on a first-come, first-served basis at the Registration Centre on Friday 27.3.2026 and Saturday 28.3.2026. The race includes parallel events and volunteering. The event follows the standards of major international races and is held on a fixed date. It is supported by local clubs and organizations, with an emphasis on environmental awareness and community participation, and includes starts and finishes from Wellness Santa Hotel.

name: 5ος Μυρμιδόνων Αθλος
description: The 5th Myrmidons Athlos is a challenging mountain running race organized by the Municipality of Farsala in collaboration with the Hellenic Federation of Popular Mass Sports and Ultrarunning Clubs, the Larissa Prefecture Marathon Runners Club, and Running Team Farsala. The race covers 21 kilometers, with approximately 1,000 meters of both elevation gain and loss, offering an exciting experience in a natural mountain setting. The 2nd Myrmidons Mini Trail is also organized alongside it, covering a shorter distance for runners seeking a shorter route. The event aims to promote sports and connection with nature in the Farsala area.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer distance with +1,000 m of elevation gain and loss
Mountain running in a natural setting around Farsala
A shorter mini-trail race is held alongside the main event
additional: The race features highly challenging routes, with an emphasis on showcasing the area's natural and cultural wealth, and welcomes participants from various age categories.

name: 5ο Pravi Trail Run
description: The EleftheroupoliRunners Sports and Cultural Association of the Municipality of Pangaio organizes the 5th Pravi Trail Run in Eleftheroupoli. The race offers three routes of 21.5 km, 12 km, and 5 km, all starting and finishing in Eleftheroupoli. The 21.5 km route is of moderate difficulty and includes trails, forest roads, and asphalt. The 12 km route is also of moderate difficulty. The 5 km route is easy and suitable for beginners, offering an introduction to trail running.
course_highlights: 21.5 km route with 16 km of trails, 2.5 km of forest roads, and 2.5 km of asphalt
12 km route with 8 km of trails, 1.5 km of forest roads, and 2.5 km of asphalt
Easy 5 km loop route for beginners to trail running
additional: Maximum participants: 300 for 21.5 km, 200 for 12 km, and 200 for 5 km. Time limit: 5 hours. Minimum age: 15; parental consent is required for participants aged 15–18. Start and finish at the Eleftheroupoli public market venue. Registration includes a commemorative gift. Registration deadline: 23/03/2026.

name: 5ο Run For Autism Half Marathon
description: The 5th consecutive Run for Autism in Ayia Napa offers a unique experience with the addition of the half-marathon distance. This charity event supports the Smile Project Day Centre for young people with autism, promoting awareness and inclusion. The courses are flat and fast, suitable for personal bests, and also include 10K and 5K races, as well as children’s races. The event attracts runners from across Cyprus and abroad, offering a festive atmosphere with music, support, and plenty of activities.
course_highlights: Half-marathon on a flat, fast two-lap course along the coastline
Passes through Ayia Napa Marina, with views of luxury yachts and crystal-clear waters
Finish at Nissi Beach, with the opportunity to cool off with a swim after the race
additional: Official pacers are available for all distances to help runners achieve their goals. The courses have aid stations with isotonic drinks, fruit, soft drinks, and medical support. Runners are encouraged to be at the start line at least half an hour before the start. Roads are closed to traffic, ensuring participants’ safety and comfort. The event includes a half-marathon, 10K, 5K, children’s races, and a 500-meter race, with the aim of raising awareness and supporting people with autism. Registration closes on 1 March 2026.

name: 8ος Δρόμος 21 Μαθητών
description: The Makrochori Cultural Association of Imathia “PSIFIDOTO,” in collaboration with the Sports Department of the Municipality of Veria and the Local Folklore Association of Makrochori and Surrounding Areas, is organizing the popular memorial race “8th Race of the 21 Students.” The event includes races for adults and children: a 10,700-meter main race, a 2,500-meter health walk, and races for primary and secondary school students. The course is on paved roads, with no significant elevation changes, and takes place in Makrochori, Imathia. The event has a charitable purpose and honors the memory of the 21 students.
course_highlights: 10,700-meter paved course with no significant elevation changes
2,500-meter health walk for adults
1,000-meter and 1,500-meter races for primary and secondary school students
additional: Online registration has closed for all categories. Late registrations are accepted only if race numbers are available, on Saturday or Sunday morning at the Makrochori Cultural Association office. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:15. Courses are on paved roads; participants take part at their own risk. Registration is through the website, with categories separated by age and race distance.

name: 8ος Κροκόδειλος Trail
description: The 8th Crocodile Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Paleochora, Chania, Crete. The 20.5-kilometer course, with 1,200 meters of elevation gain, starts on Sougia’s coastal road and follows technical trails, rocky terrain, and historic sites such as Ancient Lissos. The race combines natural beauty, challenge, and respect for the environment, offering a unique running experience in southwestern Crete. The event includes athlete transfers, a pasta party, and a post-finish meal.
course_highlights: A technical, rocky trail with 4 sharp “teeth” on the elevation profile
Passes historic sites such as the Temple of Asclepius and the ancient theater of Lissos
Views of the bay of Ancient Lissos and the South Cretan Sea
additional: Athlete transfers from Paleochora to Sougia take place about 1 hour before the start. The pasta party and race-pack pickup take place on Saturday before the race. The last athlete must pass the Gialiskari station at 10 km before the cutoff time. After the finish, there is an awards ceremony and a meal. The course is 20.5 kilometers long with 1,200 meters of elevation gain, and the race emphasizes technical difficulty and the beauty of the natural surroundings. The event also includes the 6.5-kilometer Kolisaura Run.

name: 10ος Αραφήνειος Δρόμος
location: Δημοτικό Κολυμβητήριο Ραφήνας, Ραφήνα, Ανατολική Αττική, Ελλάδα
description: The 10th Araphineios Road Race is a major celebration of sport in the Municipality of Rafina-Pikermi, which has become an established event with strong community and athletic participation. The event brings people and organizations together, showcasing the city as a vibrant center of sport and culture. Rafina’s central square is transformed into a hub of activity and entertainment, with sports activities, music, and events for all ages.
course_highlights: Event held in Rafina’s central square
Sports activities and fitness activities by PROTYPO FITNESS CLUB
Cheerleading performance and music by the Rafina-Pikermi Municipal Philharmonic
additional: Race bibs and athlete kits can be collected from 09:00 to 19:00. Activities, refreshments, and event sponsors are present throughout the day. The event includes music and sports demonstrations. The event features races on certified courses, with participants aged 6 and over, and is held with the support of the police and volunteers. Participation is free or requires a small fee, and the event is accompanied by cultural and community activities.

description: The Nafplio Marathon is a special road race that combines sport, history, and natural beauty in the beautiful city of Nafplio. Runners of all levels have the opportunity to enjoy courses passing through historic and natural landscapes while taking part in a friendly, well-organized event. The event offers a range of benefits and gives participants the opportunity to visit archaeological sites in Argolis free of charge. The Marathon is a celebration for the city and its runners, with a strong cultural character and social dimension.
course_highlights: Courses combining sport, history, and natural beauty
Free admission to the archaeological sites of Argolis for participants
Showcasing monuments and archaeological sites in Nafplio, Palamidi, Tiryns, Mycenae, and Epidaurus
additional: Participants receive a race number (BIB), electronic timing, a technical T-shirt, printed informational materials, a participation certificate, race photos, a finisher’s medal, and a bag. Registration fees can be paid only by card or IRIS. Unpaid registrations are automatically canceled. Volunteers are an important part of the event. Runners receive free admission to the archaeological sites of Argolis on race day and the following day. The event includes accompanying cultural, educational, and social activities, races for the marathon, half marathon, 5 km, and a 1 km race for students, as well as cultural programs and trips.

name: 10ος Εύκλειος Αγώνας Βουνού & 6ο Υμηττός Marathon
description: The 10th Efkleios Mountain Race and the 6th Hymettus Marathon are organized by the South Athens Runners Association “EFKLIS” and offer a unique mountain-running experience on Mount Hymettus. The routes include a variety of distances and elevation profiles, with certified courses and water stations. The event is supported by volunteer groups and local organizations, and provides electronic timing, medals, and refreshments for participants. The start is in Argyroupoli, and the atmosphere is friendly and safe for all runners.
course_highlights: 18 km course with electronic timing and live location tracking
47 km Hymettus Marathon with +2,150 m elevation gain and 2 ITRA points
Water stations at key points along the course
additional: Electronic timing uses a chip, and runners’ locations are displayed in real time. The race office distributes race packs from 07:00, strictly for athletes from outside Attica. Payment is by card online only and must be made within five days of registration. Volunteers receive an event T-shirt, a backpack, snacks, water, juice, and a medal. Mountain races and marathons, routes on Mount Hymettus, road and mountain race entries, technical T-shirts and equipment, electronic timing.

name: 14ος Βαλλιάνειος Αγώνας Δρόμου
description: The 14th Vallianeios Popular Road Race in Argostoli is one of Kefalonia’s most important and beloved sporting events, with a continuous presence for 14 years. The main 10-kilometer race follows a beautiful, accessible route along the waterfront, combining sea views with the natural landscape. Children’s races and a dedicated route for people with disabilities are also organized, reinforcing the event’s inclusive character. The event is accompanied by music, dance, and sporting activities, offering a complete celebration of sport for everyone.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the waterfront promenade lined with palm trees
Turnaround near the “Oscar” restaurant and return to the Central Square
Dedicated route for people with disabilities and children’s races ranging from 50 to 100+ meters
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal, and winners in each category are honored with special awards. The event is co-organized with the Municipality of Argostoli and held under the auspices of the Vallianeios Bequest. Last-minute registration is available for a limited number of runners only, on a first-come, first-served basis. Various routes and age categories, volunteer participation, and events for the public. Includes 10 km and children’s routes.

name: 29ος Δρόμος Κουδουμά
description: The 29th Koudoumas Run is a challenging trail-running and hiking event held in the area of Sternes, Heraklion, Crete. The 22.5-kilometer route crosses mountainous, difficult terrain, with 9 kilometers uphill and 13.5 kilometers downhill on a dirt road, starting in Sternes and finishing at the Holy Monastery of Koudoumas. The event offers free transport for athletes from Heraklion, and a meal is served to participants after the race. The event is welcoming and emphasizes safety and a positive experience for runners.
course_highlights: A challenging 22.5-kilometer mountain route
9 kilometers uphill and 13.5 kilometers downhill on a dirt road
Finish at the Holy Monastery of Koudoumas, with a meal after the awards ceremony
additional: Free bus transport for athletes from Eleftherios Venizelos Square, Heraklion, at 07:30 a.m. on race day. Race time limit: 3 hours. Prizes for the top 3 in each category and commemorative gifts for all participants. Categories by age and gender, with a minimum of 4 participants per category. Categories are available for various age groups. Transport from Heraklion; a meal is provided after the race. Participants take part at their own responsibility. Three-hour time limit.

name: PepsiCo Gives Back – Kifissia
location: Πλατεία Ηρώων Πολυτεχνείου, Κάτω Κηφισιά, Greece
description: The PepsiCo Gives Back - Kifissia event is a charity road race held in Kato Kifisia, starting and finishing at Heroes of Polytechnic Square. It features timed 5 km and 10 km races, as well as untimed 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races for students and people with disabilities. The event is open to runners of all ages, and proceeds go to charitable causes. RUNAWAY provides technical support, making this an enjoyable and socially beneficial sporting experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the circular road around Heroes of Polytechnic Square
Timed 5 km and 10 km races
Untimed 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races for students and people with disabilities
additional: The 5 km and 10 km races are timed. The 500 m and 1,000 m children’s races are untimed. Companions of people with disabilities and parents may participate without a race bib, starting at the back of the course. The event is charitable, with proceeds going to charitable causes. Registration is available through an online form, with various categories and age groups and a participation fee. The event takes place in Kato Kifisia, starting at Heroes of Polytechnic Square.

description: Run Greece Heraklion offers a unique road-running experience in the heart of Crete, with 10 km and 5 km races, a children’s race, and a Family Run. The race starts at Eleftherias Square and passes through the city’s main streets, offering beautiful views and support throughout. The organizers ensure runners’ safety and comfort with medical coverage and electronic timing. Participation is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. After finishing, runners receive a medal and a certificate of participation.
course_highlights: Start at Eleftherias Square, Dikaiosynis Avenue
Route through the city of Heraklion, with safety measures and support
Electronic timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: Registration includes a bib with an integrated electronic timing chip, a finisher’s medal, a certificate of participation with times, and an official race T-shirt. Full medical coverage is provided, including medical services and volunteer rescuers. Registrations are automatically canceled if the participation fee is not paid. Race bibs can be collected three days before the race. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social participation, with various categories and activities for the whole family.

name: Helicon Mountain Race
description: The Helicon Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held at the Krya Springs in Livadeia. It offers routes of various distances, from 5.6 km to 38 km, through a stunning natural environment with rugged terrain and lush vegetation. The race is certified by the International Skyrunning Federation and offers nature and adventure enthusiasts a unique opportunity to enjoy an unforgettable mountain-running experience. A free yoga session is also organized to help participants unwind and relax.

name: 3ο Kefalonia Backyard Ultra
description: The 3rd Kefalonia Backyard Ultra is an ultradistance backyard ultra race held in Argostoli, Kefalonia. Runners are challenged to complete a 6,706-meter loop every hour until only one winner remains. The event aims to bring participants closer to nature and challenge them to push beyond their limits, offering a unique endurance and sporting experience on the beautiful island of Kefalonia.

name: 78ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιέρας Πόλης Μεσολογγίου
description: The 78th Road of Sacrifice of the Sacred City of Mesolongi is a historic road race held as part of the celebrations marking the anniversary of the historic Exodus. The race honors the people of Mesolongi who sacrificed themselves for the ideals of freedom and is the oldest road race in the country. The course starts at the Holy Monastery of Saint Symeon, where the Free Besieged sought refuge, and finishes at the city’s Garden of Heroes, covering a total of 9,800 meters. This course is of particular historical and symbolic significance, offering participants a unique sporting and cultural experience.

name: Evia Ultra Trail
description: The Evia Ultra Trail is a demanding mountain race held in the area of Steni, Evia. It offers a unique experience for runners who love the mountains and adventure, with routes that cross natural trails and scenic landscapes. The race is an important event for the local community and attracts runners from across Greece and abroad. The organization is professional and welcoming, with an emphasis on safety and participant support.

name: Run Greece Syros
description: The Run Greece race in Syros offers a unique road-running experience, with 10 km and 5 km races, a children’s race, and a Family Run. The races start at Miaouli Square, and the routes combine urban and coastal scenery, making them ideal for runners of all levels. The event provides electronic timing, medical coverage, and medals for finishers, creating a friendly and safe environment for all participants. Adults and children can take part, with special rates for students in group registrations.

name: 1ος Μαραθώνιος Ηπείρου «Βασιλιάς Πύρρος»
description: The Epirus “King Pyrrhus” Marathon is a historic, fast marathon held in the city of Arta, on a course certified by World Athletics. The route is flat and runs along the Arachthos River, offering ideal weather conditions for runners seeking personal records. The race honors King Pyrrhus, an important ancient leader of Epirus, and combines sport with the region’s history and culture. The event includes a marathon, 10K, and 5K, and welcomes runners of all levels.

name: 2ο Amanitis Trail
organizer: Podilates Chiou – Cycling and Triathlon Club
description: Amanitis Trail 2027 offers a unique mountain-running experience in central Chios, starting from the picturesque semi-mountainous village of Avgonima, overlooking the Aegean Sea. The 40-kilometer route passes through historic and natural landscapes, including the medieval village of Anavatos and the secluded Agios Sideros, with a mix of trails, dirt roads, and panoramic views. The finish is back in Avgonima, completing an authentic adventure through the island’s nature and history. Shorter 7- and 21-kilometer routes are also available, suitable for beginners and more experienced runners, respectively.

name: 10ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Βόλου
description: The 10th Volos Half Marathon is a festive sporting event held under the auspices of the Thessaly Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS) and EOSLMA-Y. The event includes the half marathon, a 5 km city race, a 2 km Family Run, and a 500 m Kids Run, attracting thousands of participants every year. It is co-organized by the Volos Health Runners’ Club, the Municipality of Volos, the Region of Thessaly, the Magnesia Chamber of Commerce, and the University of Thessaly. Registration is exclusively online, with payment by card, and the participation package includes a commemorative T-shirt for the anniversary race. The start and accompanying races offer a unique running experience in the city of Volos.

name: 3ος Γιτάνειος Δρόμος
description: The 3rd Gitaneios Run is an important sporting and cultural event that combines athletics with the promotion of Thesprotia’s historical heritage. It includes 21 km and 5 km races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race for children aged 6 and over. The route is paved and finishes at the archaeological site of Gitana, with the finish line at the iconic Ancient Theater of Gitana. The event aims to become an established tradition that connects sport with the region’s history and culture.

name: 3ο Γρεβενά City Run
description: The 3rd Grevena City Run is a special road race held in the city of Grevena. Participants will run through the city’s central streets, climb stairways, and pass through picturesque alleys while enjoying views of the Grevenitis River. The race offers 10 km and 5 km routes, as well as a 1,000-meter race for children and a 1,000-meter walk for people with disabilities and parents with strollers. The start and finish are at Aimilianou Square in Grevena, offering a wonderful opportunity to get to know the city and experience Grevena’s hospitality.

name: 5ο Race For Autism Gr
description: The 5th Race For Autism Gr takes place in the Kavouri area of Vouliagmeni, with the aim of raising awareness and promoting equal participation in sports for neurodivergent people. The event is supported by the nonprofit organization Race for Autism Gr, which organizes amateur sporting events throughout Greece. The race promotes social inclusion and acceptance of autistic people and their families. The event is held in cooperation with the Municipality of Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni and aims to raise awareness about autism.

name: 10ος Ορεινός Αγώνας Γερανείων
description: The 10th Geraneia Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Geraneia Mountains, near Loutraki in the Peloponnese. Celebrating a decade of challenges and participation, the race offers runners a unique experience on trails and mountain routes. The event is supported by the Municipality of Loutraki and is an important sporting event for the area. It brings organizers and athletes together in a friendly, energetic atmosphere.

name: 11ος Νικηφόρειος Δρόμος
organizer: Τμήμα Αθλητισμού Δήμου Ρεθύμνης και Σύλλογος Δρομέων Υγείας Ρεθύμνου
description: The 11th Nikiforeios Race is organized by the Sports Department of the Municipality of Rethymno and the Rethymno Health Runners Club, with the support of the Region of Crete and other local organizations. The race takes place in Rethymno, starting from Kalonyktis, and includes routes along dirt roads and trails. The event features races of various distances, a children’s race, a cycling tour, and a nature walk, offering a complete sporting experience for all participants.

name: 12ος Φιλανθρωπικός Αγώνας Βουνού Αυτισμός – Ελπίδα 2026
organizer: Σύλλογος Φίλων Αυτιστικού Ατόμου της Μονάδας «ΕΛΠΙΔΑ»
description: The 12th “Autism - ELPIDA” Charity Mountain Race takes place in the suburban forest of the Municipality of Oreokastro, Thessaloniki, and includes 1 km, 5+ km, and 15 km routes. The 15 km route features elevation changes with a total elevation gain of 500 meters, offering runners a challenging and beautiful experience. The race aims to raise awareness about children with autism and support the “ELPIDA” Autism Unit. Registration includes official timing, medical support, a medal, a commemorative certificate, and a snack at the finish. A bag-drop area and toilets are also available at the start/finish area.

name: 13ο Poikilo Rocky Mountain
description: The Poikilo Rocky Mountain race takes place on Mount Poikilo in Attica, starting and finishing at Panorama Square in Petroupoli. It offers routes for everyone, from a 1 km children’s race to the longer 29 km and 18 km routes, catering to runners of different levels. The event includes full support, with timing, live results, and amenities for participants. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with awards and special packages for teams.

name: 29ος Αγώνας Δρόμου / Πεζοπορίας Κουδουμά
description: The 29th Koudoumas Mountain Run / Hike is a challenging 22.5-kilometer mountain race starting in Sternes and finishing at the Holy Monastery of Koudoumas. The route includes 9 kilometers uphill and 13.5 kilometers downhill on a dirt road, offering a unique experience in a natural mountain setting. The race is intended for runners with good physical fitness and has a 3-hour cutoff. After finishing, participants enjoy a meal and awards in a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.

The event includes races for children and adults, starting and finishing in Leuctra’s central square. It offers an enjoyable sporting experience with a nominal entry fee, promoting local sports culture and community participation. Participants are asked to arrive early to collect their timing chip.

1.5 km course for children, and 3.5 km and 10 km courses for adults
Traditional cross-country race with a local character

name: Hydra’s Trail Event
location: Hydra, Hydra Regional Unit, Attica, Greece
description: Hydra’s Trail Event is an annual trail-running race held on the island of Hydra. It offers a variety of routes for runners of all levels, from a marathon to shorter, fun runs. The event combines the challenge of nature with the beauty of the landscape, attracting large numbers of participants and volunteers. It has a long tradition and a reputation for excellent organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes with a strong mountain character and natural beauty
A variety of races, from a marathon to routes for beginners and children
Routes crossing the picturesque island of Hydra

The schedule includes multiple start times for different routes, with the first start at 07:00. The event includes medals, T-shirts, volunteer opportunities, and entries in various categories, with an emphasis on natural beauty and community.

name: 10ος Μαραθώνιος Κρήτης
description: The 10th Crete Marathon is an internationally recognized sporting event held in the beautiful city of Chania. Dedicated to the memory of the late Metropolitan Irineos Galanakis, the event includes marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and 2.5 km races, each with its own dedication and historical significance. The course starts and finishes at the Chania National Sports Center, passing by important landmarks around the city and offering a unique running experience in both urban and natural surroundings. The event is supported by the Chania Health Runners Club and local organizations, with an emphasis on quality and tradition.

name: 9ος Αγώνας Πεδίου Αρεως «Στις Γειτονιές της Αθήνας»
description: The 9th Pedion Areos Race, “In the Neighborhoods of Athens,” is organized by the Athletic Cultural Association “Athenians Runners” to showcase Pedion Areos Park and raise awareness of environmental issues. The event includes 5 km and 10 km races that start and finish inside the park, passing through the surrounding neighborhoods of Athens, as well as a 1.3 km children’s race within the park. The event emphasizes culture, fair play, and environmental awareness, offering an enjoyable experience for runners of all ages and abilities.

name: 19ος Μαραθώνιος Μεσσήνης
description: The Messini Marathon is an established road race organized by the Municipality of Messini with the support of the SEGAS Regional Association of Peloponnese. The race promotes fair play and competition, inspired by the ancient Greek tradition. Messini, with its historical significance, hosts this major sporting event, which attracts runners of various ages and levels. The event includes marathon, 10 km, and 3 km races, offering participants a range of options.

description: The Dolichos Delphi–Olympia Road Race is a challenging 255-kilometer ultramarathon with a 48-hour duration. It starts in Delphi and finishes in Ancient Olympia. The course combines 60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails with 40% paved roads, crossing central Greece and the Peloponnese via the Rio–Antirrio Bridge. The mountainous route reaches an altitude of up to 1,100 meters, with significant elevation gain and loss. The race is organized by the OLYMPIOI sports club and invites runners to test their endurance in a pioneering Greek race.
course_highlights: A 255-kilometer route with a 48-hour duration
60% forest roads, dirt roads, and trails; 40% paved roads
A mountainous route reaching up to 1,100 meters, with 5,420 meters of total elevation gain
additional: Included are transfers from Athens to Delphi and from Olympia to Athens; accommodation and meals in Ancient Olympia after the race; supplies and medical support during the race; transport in the event of withdrawal; a medal and commemorative certificate for finishers; and a guided tour of the archaeological site and museum of Ancient Olympia the following day. The race offers multiple distances (255 km, 144 km, and 111 km), with scenic surroundings and a challenging course, and takes place over three days in April. Support points and electronic tracking are available.

description: The 10th Kouri Forest Popular Road Race is organized by the Friends of Kouri Forest Association in collaboration with the Region of Thessaly, the Municipality of Almyros, and the Volos Health Runners Association “Centaur.” The event includes 5,000- and 10,000-meter races for adults, as well as 1,500- and 500-meter races for middle- and elementary-school students, respectively, and a separate 500-meter race for people with disabilities. The event has a charitable purpose, collecting food to support the Municipality of Almyros’s social grocery and Galini homes. Participation is free for children and costs 5 euros for adults. The race starts on Saturday afternoon.

1,500- and 500-meter races for students
Charitable event collecting food
additional: The event has a charitable purpose, collecting non-perishable food to support the Municipality of Almyros’s social grocery and Galini homes. Opening and closing ceremonies, participation in a natural setting, races for all ages and needs

name: Ε’ Δρόμος Γερακιού
description: The 5th Geraki Road Race is a distinctive 47.5-kilometer ultradistance race connecting the historic Byzantine castles of Mystras and Geraki in Laconia. The race follows a paved route with significant climbing, reaching an elevation of up to 650 meters, offering a unique experience combining sport, culture, and natural beauty. It is organized by the Greek Association of Long-Distance Runners “The Immortals” in cooperation with local organizations, and has a strong local and athletic character. The race starts at Mystras Castle and finishes in Geraki’s central square, with a 7-hour time limit.
course_highlights: 47.5-kilometer route between the Byzantine castles of Mystras and Geraki
Paved route with elevation ranging from 420 to 650 meters
8 aid stations staffed by volunteers along the route
additional: The day’s schedule includes registration opening at 12:00 with a pasta party, registration closing at 14:30, a technical briefing at 14:35, and transfer to the start at 14:45. The race has a 7-hour time limit, with a cutoff time of 22:00. Cutoff points are in place for the safety and smooth running of the race. The race includes 8 aid stations, a technical briefing, and a program featuring a pasta party. The route is paved, and the finishing time limit is 7 hours.

description: The Ypsilanteios Road Race in Nea Trapezounta, Pieria, is a sporting event offering three routes for everyone: a 10-kilometer race, a 1.1 km children’s race, and a 5.3 km walking route. The 10 km course is challenging, with elevation changes and beautiful views of Mount Olympus. It starts and finishes in the central square of Nea Trapezounta. The children’s race and walking route offer opportunities for younger participants and non-competitive runners. The event provides participants with medals, a light meal, and juice, while timing is overseen by the organizing committee. With medical coverage and a Pontian celebration after the race, it is a festival for the local community and runners.
course_highlights: 10 km route with +155 meters of elevation gain
Views of Mount Olympus along the route
Water stations at 3.2 and 7.7 km
additional: Registration is available exclusively on race day, up to 15 minutes before the start, in the central square. Timing is not electronic; it is overseen by the organizing committee. Medical coverage is provided by the Samaritans and Rescuers Volunteer Corps of the Hellenic Red Cross. A parent or guardian’s declaration of consent is required for minors participating in the children’s race. The awards ceremony begins at 19:00, followed by awards and a Pontian celebration. Three routes: 10 km, children’s race 1.1 km, and walking route 5.3 km. The race has +155 meters of elevation gain and a challenging course. Registration is on race day. Medal, meal, juice, manual timing, and medical coverage.

name: 1ο Amphipolis Ahepa Run
description: The 1st Amphipolis Ahepa Run is a new series of road races combining Greece’s history, culture, and sport. The routes pass along ancient paths and through the natural landscapes of Amphipolis, offering a unique running experience that honors the area’s rich cultural heritage. The event is open to runners of all levels, from children to experienced athletes, with accompanying activities and support throughout the event.

name: 1ο Kotylaion Run
description: The 1st Kotylaion Run will take place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, in the village of Koutselio, Ioannina. The event is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Ioannina, with the support of the Ioannina Runners Club, offering a unique mountain-running experience in the area. My Adventure, with many years of experience organizing sporting events in Epirus, supports the event, bringing together the area’s natural surroundings and mountainous terrain. The race is for runners who want to enjoy nature and an athletic challenge in beautiful mountain scenery.

name: 3ο Kastra Mountain Trail
description: The 3rd Kastra Mountain Trail in Servia, Kozani, is a major sporting event that attracts runners who love the mountains and nature. The course crosses the impressive natural landscape of the Pierian Mountains, offering unique mountain-running experiences. The Municipality of Servia actively supports the event and invites volunteers to contribute to its success. The event combines sport with the area’s natural beauty, creating a celebration for mountain-running enthusiasts.

name: 4ος Ορεινός Αγώνας Χανδρινού
description: The 4th Chandrino Mountain Race is organized by the Chandrino Athletic and Cultural Association “CHANDRINAIKOS” and will take place on Sunday, April 19, 2026, in Chandrino, Messinia. The event features mountain races of 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The route starts at the “Platania” park in the village and finishes at the summit of the conical Mount Prophet Elias, offering panoramic views across Messinia and the surrounding landscapes. The race combines natural beauty, athletic challenge, and local tradition, inviting runners and visitors to enjoy a unique mountain-running experience.

name: 5ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Ιστίμπεη
description: The 5th Istibei Sacrifice Run is a 14-kilometer mountain race with 600 meters of elevation gain, held at Istibei Fort, near Neo Petritsi, Serres. The race is organized by the Friends of Istibei Fort Association in collaboration with the Municipality of Sintiki, as part of the 85th anniversary of the Battle of the Forts. The event aims to preserve historical memory through sport and showcase the area’s natural wealth. The route passes over the surface of the forts of the Metaxas Line, where defenders confronted the German war machine in 1941.

name: Lake Plastiras Trail
description: Lake Plastiras Trail is a celebratory mountain running race held in the beautiful area of Lake Plastiras in Karditsa, Greece. The race routes cross the historic Agrafa mountain range, offering unique natural scenery, varied terrain, and significant elevation gains. The race starts at the Botanical Garden of the Municipality of Lake Plastiras, beside the lake, and participants can enjoy routes combining trails, dirt roads, and asphalt. The race promotes sport, recreation, and the appreciation of the region’s nature and local history.

name: Run Greece Σπάρτη
description: Run Greece Sparta 2026 offers a unique running experience in the historic city of Sparta. Participants can take part in the 10 km, 5 km, children’s race, and Family Run, catering to runners of different abilities and ages. The course starts at the Statue of Leonidas and offers support with aid stations, medical coverage, and electronic timing. With a finisher’s medal and official T-shirt, the race combines sport and culture in a welcoming event.

name: 10ο No Finish Line Athens
description: No Finish Line Athens is the largest charity running event in Greece, combining sport, recreation, and social contribution. Participants run or walk freely for 100 hours, recording kilometres that are converted into funds to support children’s programmes through the “Together for Children” Association. The event takes place at Pedion tou Areos and is a leading social and sporting event, attracting many participants and making a significant contribution to society.
course_highlights: Held at Pedion tou Areos
100-hour duration, with participants free to choose when and how far they take part
Charitable event where kilometres are converted into financial support
additional: The event lasts 100 hours, and participants can run or walk whenever they wish, with no time or distance limit. It is supported by the international organisation No Finish Line International and the “Together for Children” Association. It has had a strong social impact, with more than 50,000 participants since 2017 and significant funding for children’s programmes. The event includes various races, with the goal of recording more than 100,000 kilometres, and takes place at Pedion tou Areos, emphasising collective effort and social contribution.

name: 24ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Καλαμάτας
description: The 24th Kalamata Road Race is an official 10 km race organized by the Messinia Health Runners Club and dedicated to the Special Kindergarten and Special School. The course is certified by World Athletics and SEGAS. It is flat, paved and fast, running alongside Kalamata beach, with the start and finish at the Central Square. There are also accompanying races, including a 10 km race walk, a 1.5 km children’s race and a 500 m Special Olympics race. The event provides official results and support for runners along the course.
course_highlights: Course certified by World Athletics and SEGAS
Flat, paved and fast course alongside the beach
Start and finish at Kalamata Central Square
additional: Support stations are located at 5 km and 7.5 km along the course. Pacers are available. The 10 km race is open to participants aged 15 and over, and the 10 km race walk to those aged 12 and over. The 1.5 km children’s race is for children and parents. The 500 m Special Olympics race is for people with disabilities accompanied by escorts. Registration is online. The event includes entries in various categories, online registration and a free children’s race. The start and finish are at Kalamata Central Square, with approximately 2,000 participants of all ages.

name: Η Μάχη στο Λεβίδι 14-04-1821 «Αναγνώστης Δημήτριος Στριφτόμπολας»
organizer: Δήμος Τρίπολης, Γυμναστικός Σύλλογος Αρκαδίας, Σύνδεσμος Σωματικής Αγωγής
description: The Municipality of Tripoli, in cooperation with the SEGAS Regional Association of the Peloponnese, the Arcadia Gymnastics Club, and the “Orchomenos” Physical Education Association, is organizing road races and a power-walking event under the name “The Battle of Levidi 14-04-1821 (Anagnostis Dimitrios Striftompolas).” The races are dedicated to the first victorious battle against the Turkish occupiers, which took place in Levidi 205 years ago. The event includes 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m routes and takes place in Levidi’s central square. The event honors the historic victory and offers a celebration of sport and remembrance for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m routes in Levidi’s central square
Dedicated to the first victorious battle against the Turks in 1821
A historic and sporting event with a strong local and cultural character

Routes through a historic area, entries in various age categories, start and finish in Levidi, with commemorative gifts and cultural activities.

description: The 3rd Pallini Run is a sporting and cultural gathering held in Pallini, Attica, offering 5 km and 10 km road races as well as a 1,000 m children’s race. The race takes place on a World Athletics-certified course, mostly through beautiful Mediterranean countryside with vineyards and olive groves, on paved routes with gentle elevation changes. The start is at Eleftherias Square in Pallini, at 8:30 a.m. The event is supported by local clubs and has a charitable purpose. Participants receive a commemorative medal and hydration during the race.

Routes through Mediterranean countryside with vineyards and olive groves
Paved routes with gentle elevation changes
