description: The 5th Godzilla Xanthi Trail is a challenging mountain race held in Xanthi, offering three different routes of 30 km, 14 km, and 7 km. The 30 km route features technical trails and significant elevation gain, while the shorter routes suit runners with different experience levels, with the 7 km route serving as an ideal introduction to mountain running. The race is organized by the Xanthi Runners Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Xanthi and the Region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, offering a unique sporting experience amid the area's natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 30 km route with 28 km of trails and 1,850 m of elevation gain
14 km route with 12 km of trails and 600 m of elevation gain
Easy, circular 7 km route, ideal as an introduction to mountain running
additional: The start and finish are at Thilia. Awards ceremonies take place at 11:30 for the 7 km race and at 14:30 for the 30 km and 14 km races. A volunteer follows the last runners to provide support. Bib pickup is at Xanthi's central square on the Saturday before the race and from early morning on race day at the start area. Group registration is available for clubs and groups of runners. There are three routes of varying difficulty, with the start and finish in the Ilia area, full refreshments, and awards. The 30 km route is particularly challenging and technical, suitable for experienced runners.

name: 6ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Φαλανναίων
description: The 6th Falannai Road Race is a sporting event held in Falani, Larissa, offering an opportunity to take part in a road race that promotes mass participation in sports and a healthy lifestyle. The race is organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association, an organization with a long tradition of supporting runners, mountaineers, and cyclists. The event emphasizes social responsibility, solidarity, and a love of nature, fostering sportsmanship and a community of sports enthusiasts. The race is a celebration for runners and sports enthusiasts in the area.
course_highlights: 21.1 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities
In collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations
Focus on social cohesion and volunteerism
additional: An event featuring 21.1 km and 5 km routes, as well as a 1 km route for children and people with disabilities, in collaboration with the Municipality of Larissa and local organizations

name: 8ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Ειρήνης «Γρηγόρης Λαμπράκης»
description: The 8th Grigoris Lambrakis Peace Run is a 23-kilometer road race organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee in honor of Grigoris Lambrakis, a peace activist and martyr. The race takes place in Tripoli and follows routes connecting the city with areas such as Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista. Participation is free, and the race is part of the Arcadia Peace Committee’s annual sporting events. It is an event with historical and social significance that honors the memory and work of Grigoris Lambrakis.
course_highlights: A 23-kilometer route from Tripoli to Agios Sostis, Episkopi, Alea, and Kerasista, and back to Tripoli
Areas of historical and natural interest in Arcadia
A race centered on the birthplace of Grigoris Lambrakis
additional: Participation in the race is free. It is organized by the Arcadia Peace Committee and is part of the committee’s annual sporting events. The 2026 race was scheduled for Sunday, May 17, at 18:00 in Tripoli. Routes through various parts of Tripoli, participation by the Arcadia Peace Committee, a historical and social context, and references to previous editions.

name: 13ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμους «Γεώργιος Αποστολάκης»
description: The 13th Popular Road Race “Georgios Apostolakis” is held in Nea Chalkidona in honor of the late Mayor Giorgos Apostolakis, who left an indelible mark on the local community. The race attracts many participants and is a celebration of sport and local tradition. The event honors his contribution and love of sport, while promoting social cohesion and health through physical activity.
course_highlights: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes in an urban setting
Organized by GEORGIOS APOSTOLAKIS PARK
Includes road races and gymnastics for all ages
additional: 1,000 m and 10,000 m routes, age categories, road races and gymnastics, date: 23/05/2027

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας
description: The 22nd Sacrifice Road Race in Naousa is a running event honoring the historic heroic city and its unique traditions. The course gives participants the opportunity to enjoy the natural surroundings of Mount Vermio and the area’s rich cultural heritage. With its beautiful trails and welcoming atmosphere, Naousa is an ideal destination for runners of all ages and abilities. The race combines athletic challenge with historical remembrance and local hospitality.
course_highlights: A course at the foothills of Mount Vermio
Passing by Naousa’s historic and cultural landmarks
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful trails
additional: Naousa offers welcoming accommodation and local cuisine featuring Xinomavro wine and traditional dishes. The area is accessible by road from Thessaloniki, 90 km away, and is suitable for family excursions and adventures in nature. The event emphasizes historical remembrance, with online and in-person registration, and medals and commemorative gifts for all runners.

name: Dental Run
organizer: Athens Dental Students' Association, Greek Pharmaceutical Students' Federation, Δήμος Ζωγράφου
description: Dental Run 2026 is an inclusive road race taking place at Goudi Park on May 17. Runners of all levels are invited to take part in a 5-kilometer race, a relaxed walk, or a children’s race. The event aims to promote health and smiles, and also offers non-athletes the opportunity to participate as volunteers. The start is scheduled for 09:00 in the morning, and the event is open to everyone, with support from well-known dental care product companies.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route at Goudi Park
Option of a relaxed walk or a children’s race
Inclusive event open to runners and volunteers
additional: Those who do not wish to run can participate as volunteers. The event is supported by companies including Sensodyne, Corega, Parodontax, Elmex-Colgate, Curaprox, and Dole. It is organized to raise awareness about health, with participation options including a 5-kilometer race, a walk, and a children’s race, as well as opportunities to volunteer.

name: 5 ος Αγώνας Ολοι Μαζί Ολοι Ισοι
description: The 5th “All Together—All Equal” road race is organized by the Region of Central Greece with the assistance of the “Gefyra” (Bridge) support structure and the support of the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association “Trachina.” The race takes place at Lamia Castle and aims to raise awareness about people with disabilities. It features three routes of 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km. These are non-competitive routes, and there is no timing. Participation is free for people with disabilities and their companions.
course_highlights: 800 m, 2.5 km and 5 km routes at Lamia Castle
Start and finish at the same location at the Castle
Routes suitable for people with disabilities and their companions; non-competitive
additional: The 2.5 km and 5 km routes are open to people with disabilities and companions aged over 12. The 800 m route is for people with disabilities of any age and primary school children (ages 6–12). There is no timing, and the race is symbolic in nature. The schedule includes registration opening at 10:00, the 800 m start at 11:00, and the 2.5 km and 5 km starts at 11:30, with the event ending at 12:30. The event has a social purpose and includes children and adults, awareness-raising and cultural activities, and support from the Municipality of Lamia and the Fthiotida Runners’ Association.

name: 8ο Life Run
location: Attica Botanical Garden, Chaidari, Attica, Greece

name: 13ος Πράσινος Ημιμαραθώνιος Λευκάδας
description: The 13th Green Lefkada Half Marathon is a night race organized by the Lefkada «Filandros» Athletic Club in collaboration with the Municipality of Lefkada and the Region of the Ionian Islands. The event includes 21.1 km and 8 km races, as well as a 1 km children’s race for ages 6–12. The start and finish are at the Lefkada Cultural Center, and the course runs around the lagoon, offering a unique running experience with sunset views. The race is held under the auspices of the EAS SEGAS Epirus and EOSLMA-Y.
course_highlights: Night race starting at 19:45
Course around the Lefkada lagoon
Start and finish at the Lefkada Cultural Center
additional: Schedule of events includes bib and chip collection, a pasta party, and awards. Children’s races have separate start times. The 8 km race starts at 17:45 and the 1 km children’s race at 16:30. Distances: 21.097 m and 8 km; races for children ages 6–12; parallel activities; courses in a protected NATURA area.

name: 22ος Δρόμος Θυσίας «Αγγελής Γοβιός»
location: Κεντρική πλατεία Ψαχνών, Ψαχνά, Ευβοίας, Greece
description: The “Angelis Govios” Road of Sacrifice is a historic road race being held for the 22nd year in Psachna, Evia, organized by the Psachna Runners and Walkers Association under the auspices of the Municipality of Dirfys-Messapia. The race includes 15 km, 5 km, and 1 km routes for children and people with disabilities, honoring the memory of the great Evian revolutionary military leader Angelis Govios and the late Mayor Giorgos Psathas. The race starts in Psachna’s central square, and entry is free, with ample refreshments provided. The 15 km route is 50% unpaved, with a total elevation gain of +131 meters, while the 5 km and 1 km routes are entirely on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
course_highlights: 15 km route with 50% unpaved terrain and +131 m elevation gain.
5 km and 1 km routes on asphalt with minimal elevation gain.
Start in Psachna’s central square.
additional: Registration takes place on race day at the start area and is free. Registration opens at 15:00. Ample refreshments are provided for runners. The event takes place on 29 May 2027, with the race starting at 17:00. It includes routes for all ages and levels, promoting sport and historical remembrance.

name: Run For Stroke
location: Μητροπολιτικό Πάρκο «Αντώνης Τρίτσης», Αγίοι Ανάργυροι, Αττική, Greece
description: The Run For Stroke road race is organized by Stroke Hope Urban Non-Profit Company in cooperation with NeuroLife IKE, with the aim of raising awareness about prevention and supporting people affected by stroke. The event takes place at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park and includes a 5 km race for runners and a 1 km race for children and people with disabilities. The race began in 2024 and aims to connect physical activity with health and social awareness. Technical direction is provided by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY.
course_highlights: Routes within Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park
5 km dirt route consisting of two 2.5 km laps
1 km route for children and people with disabilities
additional: Eligibility: 5 km for people over 12 years of age with a medical certificate of fitness. 1 km for children aged 6–12, people with disabilities, and patients. The race includes runners and walkers. Technical direction by WeRun, with support from RUNAWAY. The event will take place on Saturday, May 23, 2026, starting at 18:30, at Antonis Tritsis Metropolitan Park. The terrain includes park trails and promotes health and social awareness.

name: Ursa Trail
description: The Ursa Trail in Metsovo is a challenging mountain race offering distances for all runners, from the 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain to shorter distances of 40 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as the 4.6 km Katara Vertical race. The course crosses beautiful trails and mountains in the area, offering unique natural scenery and technical challenges. The race is ITRA-certified and is an important event for mountain-running enthusiasts in Greece. The organizers provide for athletes’ safety and support, with aid stations and technical assistance along the course.
course_highlights: 100 km ultramarathon with 5,700 m of elevation gain
40 km, 21 km, and 11 km races, plus a 4.6 km vertical race
Beautiful mountain trails in Metsovo with technical challenges
additional: Races start at different times depending on the distance. Aid stations and technical support are available along the courses. The race is ITRA-certified and awards UTMB points for the 100 km ultramarathon. Information about accommodation and transport in the area is also provided. Ursa Trail also includes children’s races and special challenges, such as the 65.6 km URSA CHALLENGE with 4,810 m of elevation gain. The event combines racing and hiking, with an overnight stay in Metsovo and the involvement of volunteers and local organizations.

name: Epidavrios Dromos Theater 2 Theater
location: Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus, Epidavros, Greece

name: 6ο Vasiliki Lefkada
description: The 6th Vasiliki Lefkada Road & Mountain Races 2026 will take place on May 30–31 in Vasiliki, Lefkada. This two-day event features road races and mountain running, organized by the Lefkada Tourism Company and the Tourism and Culture Association of the wider area. Events include races for children on scooters, an exciting 3,500-meter aquathlon combining swimming and running, and the classic 13,000-meter road race, which starts at Porto Katsiki Beach. The main road race starts at 18:00, offering a unique sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting.

name: 29ος Γύρος Πόλεως
description: The 29th City Run in Kyparissia is organized by the Municipality of Trifylia and will take place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, starting and finishing at the town’s central square. The event includes races for all ages, from toddlers to adults, over distances ranging from 100 meters to 10 kilometers. Participation is free, all finishers will receive a commemorative medal, and the top finishers in each category will be awarded. It is a celebration of sport that brings together the local community and runners of all ages on a beautiful route through the town.

name: 5TH EVRYTANIA TRAIL RACES
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 60 km, Μαραθώνιος, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 12 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The organizers of the 5th Evrytania Trail Races invite you to run along the fir-covered trails of mountainous Evrytania, in one of Europe’s cleanest ecosystems. The races offer a unique opportunity to discover the magic of nature, cool off in the crystal-clear waters of the Krikellopotamos River, and enjoy the hospitality of traditional villages that serve as aid stations. The event includes races of different distances, suitable for beginner and experienced runners, with beautiful and challenging routes combining trails, dirt roads, and paved roads.

name: 2οι Ορεινοί Αγώνες Τρεξίματος Χαλκιόπουλοι Βάλτου
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιοπουλιτών Αθήνας – Πειραιά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The 2nd Mountain Trail Races on the Trails of the Valtos Fighters — Chalkiopoulo Trail Run 2026 — will take place on Sunday, May 31, 2026, in Neo Chalkiopoulo, Valtos, Aetolia-Acarnania, with the start at 9 a.m. The event is organized by the Chalkiopoulians of Athens–Piraeus Association “Saint Andrew the Hermit,” the Chalkiopoulo Cultural and Educational Association, the local Chalkiopoulo Community, and the Municipality of Amfilochia. The races include two distances, 27 and 10 kilometers, crossing the beautiful mountain landscapes of Chalkiopoulo and Valtos and offering a unique trail-running experience.

name: 5η Γιορτή Αθλητισμού Δήμου Γαύδου
description: The 5th Gavdos Municipality Sports Festival is an open celebration of mass participation sports held on the island of Gavdos during the three-day Holy Spirit holiday. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and fair play, giving residents and visitors the opportunity to take part. The races feature routes that showcase the island’s natural beauty and trails, offering a unique experience at the southernmost point of Europe. The event has become an established institution, with strong participation and excellent organization.

name: 5ο Posidonia Running Event
description: The 5th Posidonia Running Event will take place on May 31, 2026, in Piraeus, offering a 5-kilometer route through the city streets. The event welcomes runners from around the world and combines sport with support for charitable causes, as proceeds will go to the Municipality of Piraeus and its partner charities. The start and finish will be at the Municipal Theatre of Piraeus, with the race starting at 9:00 a.m. The event is part of the international Posidonia 2026 shipping exhibition and promises a unique experience for participants.

name: 5ο Rock Solid Kastellorizo
description: The 5th Rock Solid Kastellorizo is a small trail-running weekend held on Kastellorizo in late May. It features 22 km, 10 km, 5 km and 1.3 km routes, all starting from the same point. The main 22 km route is mountainous, with significant elevation gain, and requires serious preparation, while the shorter routes offer a friendlier, more sociable atmosphere. The race is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Federation of Mountain Sports and offers medals, plaques and prizes to the winners and the first local finishers.

name: 6ο Karya Olympus Trail
description: Karya Olympus Trail is a mountain running race held in Karya, offering a unique experience for runners who love nature and the challenge of the mountains. The race showcases the beauty of Mount Olympus and the surrounding area, combining demanding trails with breathtaking views. It is an event that attracts runners of all levels, with the aim of promoting sport and local tradition. The organizers are welcoming and support participants every step of the way.

name: 42ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Διστόμου
description: The 42nd Distomo Sacrifice Road Race is a memorial race taking place on Sunday, May 31, 2026, in Distomo, honoring the victims of the 1944 massacre. The 11.2 km course starts at the historic site of Karakolithos and finishes at National Resistance Square. Entry is free, and a 1.1 km children’s race starts at the same time. The organizers provide transportation for runners, timing, medical coverage, and refreshments along the course and at the finish.

name: Mystras Trail
organizer: Δήμος Σπάρτης και ο Σύλλογος Σπαρτιάτες Δρομείς
description: The Mystras Trail 2026 race is organized by the Municipality of Sparta and the Spartans Runners Club, with the support of the Sparta Mountaineering Club, as part of the Paleologian celebrations. It is a challenging mountain race featuring three circular routes of different distances, with starts from 09:00 to 10:00 on the morning of May 31, 2026. The routes cross technical trails with loose ground and stones, offering a challenge for experienced runners. The event provides electronic timing, refreshment stations, and a race T-shirt for all participants.

name: Sifnathlon
organizer: Δήμος Σίφνου και Ένωση Συμμετασχόντων σε Ολυμπιακούς Αγώνες
description: SiFNaThLoN 2026 in Sifnos invites runners and swimmers to enjoy a unique sporting experience on one of the most charming islands in the Cyclades. The events take place over two days, with open-water swimming on May 30 and road races on May 31, amid Sifnos’s enchanting scenery, including Platis Gialos Beach and the Kamares area. The running routes combine paved roads and dirt tracks, offering participants a variety of terrain. The event brings together sport and the beauty of the Aegean, and is ideal for athletes of all ages and levels.

name: Karya Olympus Trail
description: The Karya Olympus Trail 2026 offers a unique mountain-running experience in the idyllic Karya Valley, under the protection of Mount Olympus. The routes follow marked trails with different distances and elevation gains, suitable for runners of all levels. The event includes races of 25, 13 and 5 kilometers, as well as children’s races, with amenities such as electronic timing, commemorative medals and technical T-shirts. The races start early in the morning, while the awards ceremony takes place at the start-finish area. The region offers natural beauty and historical interest, making the race a complete sporting and cultural experience.

name: Titnata Trail
description: The Titnata Trail 13km is a short mountain running race held in Karya, Greece. The 13-kilometer course includes 760 meters of ascent, offering a challenging uphill run on a marked trail. The race starts at 08:50 and is limited to 200 runners. Finishers receive a commemorative technical T-shirt.

name: Αγώνας δρόμου ιστορικής μνήμης «Βασιλί – Δασόλοφος»
organizer: Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Βασιλί και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δασολόφου
description: The “Vasili–Dasolofos” Historical Remembrance Road Race is organized by the Vasili Cultural Association and the Dasolofos Cultural and Beautification Association in memory of the 40 Greeks executed in 1944. The race starts from the square in Vasili and passes through historic and scenic spots in the area, honoring the memory of the heroes and promoting unity and historical awareness. After the finish, a memorial service will be held at the monument to the fallen. The event combines sport with culture and history, inviting participants to send a message of remembrance and respect.

name: Karya Mini Trail
description: The Karya Mini Trail is part of the Karya Olympus Trail, held in Karya, an idyllic valley on Mount Olympus. The 5-kilometer course follows a marked trail with 285 meters of positive elevation gain, offering a beautiful mountain-running experience. The event also includes longer routes and children’s races, with amenities such as electronic timing, souvenirs, and refreshments. With its rich history and natural beauty, Karya offers a unique setting for runners and visitors.

name: Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Νέας Σμύρνης
organizer: δήμος Νέας Σμύρνης και Περιφέρεια Αττικής
description: The Nea Smyrni Night Run 2026 is a 5-kilometer road race organized by the Municipality of Nea Smyrni in collaboration with the Attica Region and the Nea Smyrni Commercial Association, as part of World Environment Day. The race has an athletic, ecological, and recreational character, with the aim of promoting environmental protection and sustainable development. The course follows the axis of El. Venizelou Street, with the start and finish at 54 Omirou Street. A concert and party follow the race, while local businesses take part with special offers and discounts.

name: Δρόμος της Ελιάς
description: The Olive Road is a traditional road race held in Gargalianoi, Messinia. The route starts and finishes in the central square of Gargalianoi, offering a beautiful running experience in a scenic area. The race is participation-focused and open to runners of all levels, promoting physical activity and health. It is organized in cooperation with the Central and Southern Peloponnese Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS) and the Municipality of Trifylia.

name: Global Day Run
description: Global Day Run Patras 2026 is a friendly running event held in Agia, Patras, with the aim of promoting running as a way to improve physical and mental health. The event includes 8 km and 4 km races, as well as a 1 km children’s race, primarily for beginner runners and recreational athletes who want to exercise outdoors with friends. The race is part of the global celebration of running, encouraging families and friends to take part without competition. The start takes place on the afternoon of Saturday, June 6, 2026, on Agia Beach.

name: 1ο Vlasti Wind Trail
description: Vlasti Wind Trail is a distinctive mountain running event held in the natural surroundings of Vlasti, Kozani. It combines the sporting experience with the promotion of harmonious coexistence between people and nature, emphasizing Renewable Energy Sources and sustainable development. The event is a celebration of sustainability and local cooperation, supporting the local community and highlighting the value of clean energy. The routes offer a unique experience through beautiful natural scenery, with respect for the environment and local tradition.

name: 2ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Κουρούτας
description: The 2nd Kourouta Road Race 2026 invites runners to take on a route where the road meets the waves, offering unique views of the Aegean Sea. The event includes 10 km and 4,300 m races, as well as a 1,000 m children’s race, with electronic timing and a commemorative medal for all finishers. Medical coverage is provided by the Red Cross, while traffic safety is ensured by the Amaliada Traffic Police and volunteers. The start and awards ceremony take place in Kourouta Central Square, creating a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

name: 2o Sykourio Trail
organizer: Δήμος Τεμπών και ο Σύλλογος Εμποροβιοτεχνών Συκουρίου
description: The 2nd Sykourio Trail is a mountain running race held in the Sykourio area of the Municipality of Tempi, on Mount Kissavos, on June 7, 2026. It features three courses of varying difficulty and length, crossing trails, dirt roads, and asphalt to offer a complete mountain running experience. The race is open to runners of all ages, with a special course for children within the settlement. The organizers provide electronic timing, refreshments, and water along the course and at the finish.

name: 4ος Συκάρειος Δρόμος
description: The 4th Sykareios Run is a road race held in Kryoneri, Attica, on Sunday, June 7, 2026. It offers two distances, 15 km and 5.5 km, with the start and finish at the Kryoneri Municipal Unit Gate. The race is open to runners of various ages and offers commemorative medals to all finishers, as well as awards to the top male and female runners. The event emphasizes runner safety and support, with refreshment stations along the route.

name: 4ο Argithea Mountain Race
description: The 4th Argithea Mountain Race is a demanding mountain race held in the area of Petrito, Karditsa, on June 7, 2026. It features several routes, including the 30 km Argithea Skyrace with 2,000 m of elevation gain, the 15 km Vlachogiannis race with 700 m of climbing, a 5 km family race, and a 1 km children’s race. There is also the 3.6 km Lakos Vertical route with 700 m of climbing, offering a unique experience on trails through a fir forest with views of the Agrafa peaks. The race attracts runners who love the mountains and a challenge, while also offering activities for the whole family.

name: 5ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Aqua Mare
description: The 5th Aqua Mare Road Race takes place in Megara, with the start and finish on Varea Beach, in front of the AQUA MARE beach bar. Participants can choose between two distances, 10 km and 5.3 km, running alongside the waves on a beautiful coastal route. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with free transportation and a commemorative T-shirt for runners. The race starts early in the morning, making for a day full of adrenaline and relaxation.

name: 6ο Raches Run
description: The 6th Raches Run - Agroinvest is a sporting event organized by the Raches Interactive Association ALOPI at Raches Beach in Phthiotis. It includes 10,000-meter and 5,000-meter races, as well as a 1,000-meter race for children, promoting sports and social solidarity. The race showcases the beauty and history of the area while strengthening participants’ connection with the village and local community.

name: Artemida Sunset Run
description: The Artemida Sunset Run is the first road race to be held in Artemida, offering 5 km and 10 km routes at sunset. The routes are pre-established and marked on public roads, with the start and finish at the Artemida Municipal Stadium. The event includes electronic timing, participant medals, an event T-shirt, and awards by age category. The race is open to runners aged 15 and over, with a total participation limit of 300 runners across both distances.

name: Kilkis Trail
description: Kilkis Trail is organized by the Kilkis Runners’ Health Association and offers a variety of races, including the main 20-kilometer trail race, a 4.8 km fun run, a 4x4.8 km relay, and a 1 km children’s race. The Kilkis Trail course follows trails and dirt roads around the city of Kilkis, with short climbs and technical sections, covering approximately 850 meters of elevation gain. The start and finish are at the Kilkis open-air cinema, offering runners a beautiful and challenging experience. The race takes place on Sunday, June 7, 2026, and is open to runners of all levels.

name: Vamvakou Mountain Run
description: The 6th Vamvakou Mountain Run, taking place on June 7, 2026, invites runners of all levels to discover the rhythm of the mountain across three routes of 29, 19, and 7 kilometers. The route starts from Vamvakou’s square and climbs to an elevation of up to 1,900 meters, offering a unique experience in one of the Peloponnese’s most authentic mountain landscapes. The race combines athletic competition with an escape from the urban pace, while the event includes electronic timing, medals, awards, and prize draws. The event is part of the Vamvakou Revival initiative and is supported by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation.

name: 5ος Δρόμος Βουφράδος
description: The 5th Voufrados Run, organized by the Hatzi Cultural Association “Anagennisi” in cooperation with the Municipality of Messini and the Messini Sports Club, includes 20 km and 5 km running and power-walking events, as well as a 1,500 m race. The courses are semi-mountainous and pass around the village of Hatzi in Messenia, showcasing natural beauty and forgotten settlements. The event aims to promote physical activity and improve quality of life through physical and mental well-being. The start and finish are at Hatzi’s central square, in a friendly and welcoming setting for all participants.

name: 5ο Livadia Night Run
description: The 5th Livadia Night Run is a night race held in Livadeia, near the Erkinas springs in the Krya area. The event features three distances: a 10 km main race, a 5 km race, and a 1 km race for students, welcoming runners of all ages and abilities. The race starts at 20:00, and timing is provided by CHRONOLOG using electronic chips. It is organized by the Athletic Swimming Club of Livadeia in cooperation with the Municipality of Livadeia, offering a local sporting experience in a beautiful natural setting.

name: 5ο Olympic Day Run
description: The 5th Olympic Day Run in Ancient Olympia is a unique and official Olympic running event that honors Greece as the birthplace of the Olympic Games. The race brings together Olympians, Paralympians, and distinguished athletes, creating a large Olympic running team. The event includes 8,000 m, 4,000 m, and 1,500 m races, with routes passing through the archaeological site and the ancient stadium of Olympia, offering a unique sporting and cultural experience. The event is held under the auspices of the Hellenic Olympic Committee and other important organizations, with the aim of highlighting Olympic heritage.

name: 16ος Ανδάνειος Δρόμος
description: The 16th Andaneios Run, covering 17,000 meters, will take place on Saturday, June 13, 2026, starting at the Arcadian Gate of Ancient Messene and finishing in Diavolitsi. A 5,000-meter race and a 1,000-meter children’s race will also be held. The event is part of two days of activities that include events about Ancient Andania, hiking routes, and tours of the wider area, offering participants a complete experience. The Messinia Runners’ Association welcomes all runners to enjoy this unique sporting and cultural experience.

name: Ιεράπετρα City Run in Stadium Vol 6
location: Municipal Stadium Vouzounerakeio, Ierapetra, Crete, Greece
description: Ierapetra City Run in Stadium Vol 6 is an evening running event held inside the Vouzoneerakeio Municipal Stadium in Ierapetra, Crete. The race is organized by the Ierapetra Health Runners Club in cooperation with the Region of Crete and offers officially timed races with a lively stadium atmosphere, music, lights, and refreshments. The program includes a 400-meter children’s race, 5- and 10-kilometer races, and a mixed 4 x 800-meter relay. Participants enjoy a unique experience inside the stadium, with support and awards for the top runners.

name: 10ο Πέρασμα Του Αποστόλου Παύλου
organizer: Δημο Πυδνας Κολινδρου και Αθλητικός Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Δρομέων Ν. Πιερίας «ΥΓΕΣ»
description: The 10th Anniversary “The Passage of the Apostle Paul” Road Race is organized by the Holy Metropolis of Kitros, Katerini and Platamon, the Municipality of Pydna-Kolindros, and the “ZEUS” Athletic and Cultural Runners’ Association of Pieria. The race is 10,000 meters long and follows a paved route through the villages of Methoni and Makrygialos. The start is at the Church of the Apostle Paul in Methoni’s central square, and the finish is at Ancient Pydna. It is a scenic route with gentle ascents and descents, marked along its entire length.

name: 8ο Γράμμος Mountain Run
description: The 8th Grammos Mountain Run is a challenging mountain race held in the beautiful Mastorochoria region, in the village of Plikati, Municipality of Konitsa. It features two routes, 21 km and 10 km, both starting and finishing in the village square. The 21 km route follows the ridge of the Grammos mountain range, with a total elevation difference of over 1,680 meters, offering a unique experience for runners with good fitness and mountain-running experience. The race starts at 10:00 a.m. for the 21 km and at 10:30 a.m. for the 10 km, with full support and amenities for participants.

name: 13ος Δρόμος Σέιχ Σου
description: The 13th Seich Sou Run is a trail-running race organized by the Thessaloniki Health Runners’ Association. The routes include 10 km, 16 km, and a 3 km fun run through Thessaloniki’s Seich Sou peri-urban forest. The race aims to introduce citizens to the natural environment and promote exercise and forest conservation. The event is supported by O.M.A.K. Kalamaria and offers an opportunity for easy trail running in a natural and historic setting.

name: 2ο Φεστιβάλ Αθλητισμού Δυτικής Μάνης
description: The 2nd West Mani Sports Festival is a two-day sporting event held in Stoupa, Messinia, by the sea. It includes open-water swimming at distances of 0.5 km, 1 km and 2 km, running, children’s races and aquathlon. The 500-meter course is triangular, with electronic timing and awards. All participants receive a medal, bib, swim cap, technical T-shirt and local products. The event is organized by the Municipality of West Mani, and proceeds support the volunteer association West Mani GAIA.

name: 9ο Koufalia Hill Run «Δήμητρα Ιορδανίδου»
description: The Koufalia Hill Run “Dimitra Iordanidou” is a distinctive event that combines the natural beauty of the Koufalia hills with an athletic challenge. It features 6- and 10-kilometer courses, mainly on dirt trails through a pine forest, with climbs and descents offering unique views of landmarks such as the Monastery of Gregory Palamas and Gavanas Cave. The event has a family-friendly character, with parallel activities for children and parents, and aims to promote sports and connection with nature in the local community. It honors the memory of Dimitra Iordanidou, who conceived the race and established it as an annual tradition.

name: Beyond Kerkini Running Experience
description: Beyond Kerkini Running Experience is a unique running event held at the Lithotopos Marina, next to Lake Kerkini. It offers routes combining varied landscapes and terrain, from flat paved roads to challenging mountain trails. Each route offers a distinctive view of the area’s natural beauty, with the chance to run among waterside rocks and through landscapes that change from sunrise to sunset. The event also includes free activities for families and children, making it a full-day sporting experience for everyone.

name: 3ο Panetoliko Mountain Trail Run
description: The 3rd Panetoliko Mountain Trail Run invites you to discover the wild, unexplored beauty of Mount Panetoliko through three spectacular routes. The races offer a unique mountain-running experience, with fir-covered slopes, waterfalls, alpine peaks, and scenic trails. The event welcomes both experienced runners and newcomers to the sport, offering electronic timing, refreshments, and transportation to and from the city of Agrinio. Experience the magic of the mountain and create unforgettable memories.

name: 3ο Galatsi Night Run
description: The 3rd Galatsi Night Run is a nighttime running event held in Galatsi, Athens, starting and finishing at the Galatsi Indoor Olympic Gymnasium – PALAIS. The 5 km course follows the city’s main road, Veikou Avenue. There is also a 1 km children’s race for primary school pupils within the PALAIS grounds. The event encourages citizens to take part in sport and physical exercise, with an emphasis on safety and an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: 5ο Orestis Run
description: The 5th ORESTIS Road Race in Orestiada is a sporting event that attracts runners and sports enthusiasts from the area. The race offers an opportunity to take part in an organized route through the city, promoting health and physical activity. The event is friendly and open to everyone, aiming to strengthen the local community and promote sport. It has become an important sporting occasion for the Orestiada area.

name: Go Florina – Run The City Experience
description: The Municipality of Florina and GoEvents are organizing the two-day GO FLORINA - RUN THE CITY running event, a sporting and cultural occasion that combines athletics with the beauty of the city of Florina. The races take place on June 20 and 21, starting and finishing at Georgiou Modi Square. Runners of all ages and abilities are invited to take part in routes through the city and along the Sakoulevas River, enjoying the area’s distinctive atmosphere. The event includes 10 km and 5 km races, a 3 km night race, and a 1 km participation run for families and children.

name: 25ο «Στα Χνάρια του Απόστολου Παύλου»
description: The 25th “In the Footsteps of the Apostle Paul” Road Race and Power Walking event is organized by the Municipality of Corinth and symbolically retraces the route taken by the Apostle Paul in the area. The race takes place on Sunday, June 21, 2026, starting at the ancient port of Cenchreae and finishing at the main square of Ancient Corinth. The route is 11.4 kilometers long and includes three support stations along the way. It is a historic and cultural route that combines sport and tradition.

name: SNF Nostos Run
description: The SNF Nostos Run 2026 is a much-loved evening road race organized by the Stavros Niarchos Foundation, returning on June 23 to celebrate 30 years of the Foundation’s philanthropic work. The race includes 10 km and 6 km routes, as well as a 1 km route for Special Olympics athletes, starting at the Panathenaic Stadium and finishing at the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Center. The event emphasizes giving and solidarity: the Foundation will contribute three times the total amount raised through participation fees to support nonprofit organizations. Along the route, participants will enjoy music from percussion bands, with a DJ set at the finish. Timing is official, but the race is non-competitive.

name: 2ο Silk City Run
description: The 2nd Silk City Run in Soufli is a road race inviting amateur and experienced runners, families, and young people to enjoy a unique route through the city of silk. Running through the streets of Soufli is not just a race, but a journey toward a healthier, more balanced, and creative way of life. The Municipality of Soufli warmly welcomes all participants, offering an opportunity for renewal and energy.

name: 11ες Ορεινές Διαδρομές Βοριτσίου
description: The 11th Voritsi Mountain Routes is a mountain running event held in Voritsi, Heraklion, Crete, on June 27, 2026. The event offers a variety of routes through beautiful natural landscapes and across varied terrain, ideal for runners who love adventure and the mountains. It gives athletes and nature lovers the opportunity to enjoy Crete’s beauty through a well-organized and welcoming sporting experience.

name: 22ος Olympus Marathon
description: The Olympus Marathon is a unique 44-kilometer mountain race with a positive elevation gain of +3,350 meters, held on the mythical Mount Olympus. The route starts at the archaeological site of Dion and follows trails through forests, alpine meadows, and peaks, reaching Litochoro. The race honors the ancient tradition of pilgrims who climbed Mount Olympus to pay tribute to Zeus, offering runners a unique experience as they follow the traces of history on the mountain of the gods. It is a certified SKYRUNNING race and a challenge for experienced mountain runners.

name: Porto Heli Night Run
description: The Municipality of Ermionida and the Municipal Community of Porto Heli invite you to the major sports celebration “Porto Heli Night Run,” taking place on Saturday, June 27, 2026. The race is dedicated to the memory of Minas Kyriakou and offers events for everyone, from an 11 km trail run and a 5 km night run to children’s races and a race for people with disabilities. Every participant will receive a commemorative T-shirt and medal, making for a unique sporting experience in beautiful Porto Heli.

name: 4ος Δρόμος Θυσίας Κακολύρι 1944
organizer: Δήμος Κύμης – Αλιβερίου και Πολιτιστικός Σύλλογος Ταξιαρχών
description: The 4th “Kakolyri 1944” Memorial Run honors the victims of the 1944 massacre in the village of Taxiarches. It is organized by the Municipality of Kymi-Aliveri and the Taxiarches Cultural Association, with support from cultural associations and communities in the area. The event includes a 21 km half-marathon, a 5 km race, and a 1.2 km children’s race, with routes passing through historic villages and natural landscapes. The race offers electronic timing, commemorative medals and T-shirts, as well as full support with aid stations and medical coverage.

name: Coast To Coast Run
description: The Coast to Coast Run in Ierapetra, Crete, is a 21,100-meter half marathon that starts at Pachia Ammos Beach and finishes at Minos Square in Ierapetra, crossing the narrowest point of Crete amid beautiful natural scenery and the Ha Gorge. A 5,000-meter race and a 1,000-meter children’s race are also held in the town of Ierapetra. The event has a cultural and tourism focus, offering a unique experience that connects the northern and southern coasts of Eastern Crete. The organizers provide transportation for athletes and ensure the races are held safely.

name: 8ο Skloupo Trail Run
description: The 8th Skloupo Trail Run is a trail race held in the picturesque village of Ampelochori (Skloupo), in the Municipality of North Tzoumerka. It features three routes: 13.5 km, 5 km, and a 1 km Kids Race, offering a unique experience through fir and conifer forests, with steep climbs and descents. The course combines dirt trails and paved sections, passing beautiful natural landscapes and historic sites in the village. The race is open to runners of all ages, with special care for younger participants.

name: 3ο Πολύλοφος Run
description: The 3rd Polylophos Run is organized by the Polylophos Messinia Cultural Association in cooperation with the Municipality of Messini. The event features running and power walking races over 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m courses around the community of Polylophos. The course is mixed, with asphalt and dirt sections, and starts and finishes in the central square of the local district. The event aims to encourage athletes and recreational exercisers to take part in physical activity that improves health and quality of life, while showcasing the area’s natural beauty.

name: 5ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Κουρκούλας
description: The 5th Kourkoula Night Race is a distinctive nighttime 5.5- and 11-kilometer road race held on Mount Kourkoula in Glykovrysi, Laconia. The race offers a unique experience where the light comes not from the sun but from the runners themselves, with headlamps lighting every step. The route combines exercise with a sense of exploration and enjoyment of the moment, creating an almost meditative calm. It is a challenge for those who want to experience something different and enjoy the night with determination and energy.

name: 4ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Μυτιλήνης
description: The 4th Mytilene Night Run is a popular nighttime road race held in the city of Mytilene. The 5- and 10-kilometer routes cross the city, starting and finishing at Tsamakia, with much of the course running along pedestrian streets to minimize disruption to traffic. The race is organized by the Lesvos Runners Association in cooperation with the Municipality of Mytilene and other local organizations, offering a unique running experience under the night sky. High participation and a warm atmosphere characterize the race, which has become an established event on the island of Lesvos.

name: 15ος Faethon Skyrace
description: The 15th Faethon Skyrace “Apostolos Tsourekas” will take place on July 12, 2026, in Kokkinopilos on Mount Olympus. This is a demanding mountain race offering two courses: the 23 km Faethon SkyRace, with 1,800 m of elevation gain over alpine terrain, and the 14 km Faethon Trail, with 400 m of elevation gain, which crosses historic trails and lush forests. The event also includes the 1 km children’s race, Faethonaki Run, giving children the opportunity to discover mountain running. The race starts from the main square of Kokkinopilos village, and the event embodies a vision and love for Mount Olympus and mountain running.

name: Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR)
description: The Zagori Mountain Running (ZMR) race is the largest mountain running event in Greece, offering a unique experience amid the natural beauty and culture of the Zagori region. With routes crossing stone bridges and villages and passing through the impressive Vikos Gorge, runners can test their endurance on challenging trails with significant elevation changes. ZMR features multiple routes, from a 5 km race for everyone to the two-day 93 km Challenge, catering to different levels of difficulty and experience. The event is welcoming and professional, with an emphasis on athlete safety and support.

name: 15ο Zagori Mountain Running
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 60 km, 33 km, Ημιμαραθώνιος, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Zagori Mountain Running race is Greece’s largest mountain running event, offering a unique experience through the imposing landscapes of Zagori. The routes cross stone bridges, the Vikos Gorge, and the Tymfi mountain range, combining natural beauty with challenging terrain. With a range of route options from 5 km to 93 km, the race caters to all preferences and levels of runners. The event is welcoming and well organized, with an emphasis on safety and athlete support.

name: Ο Δρόμος του Αλατιού
description: The Road of Salt is a running event held in Messolonghi, offering 10 km, 5 km, and 1,000 m races. The event emphasizes accurate electronic timing and excellent organization, aiming to provide an unforgettable experience for runners from all over Greece. It combines sporting spirit with local tradition, attracting participants of all ages and abilities. The organizers ensure prompt publication of results and provide commemorative certificates of participation.

name: 10ο WAVE Running
description: The 10th WAVE Running returns in full force on July 24–25, 2026, along the Keramoti–Avdira coastline, with its main base at Myrodato Beach in Xanthi. The anniversary event offers three routes of 5 km, 10 km, and 28 km through the unique natural environment of the Nestos Delta. Side events highlight the character and philosophy of the event, including beach cleanups, an exhibition of local products, and musical performances, creating a celebration of sport, nature, and culture.

name: I Run Myrtos
description: The Myrtos Cultural Association, in collaboration with the Ierapetra Health Runners’ Association, organizes the I Run Myrtos race, featuring 12.2-kilometer and 5-kilometer routes, as well as a 750-meter children’s race. The event takes place in Myrtos Square and offers electronic timing and aid stations. The course is mostly paved, with little elevation change, and is suitable for runners of all ages. The race has a friendly atmosphere, with awards and commemorative medals for all participants.

name: 2ο Oinousses Run
description: The 2nd Oinousses Run is a unique event that combines running and cycling on the enchanting island of Oinousses. The 13 km running route passes the historic Monastery of the Annunciation and offers impressive views of Chios, while the 20 km cycling route makes a complete circuit of the island, with gentle climbs and fast descents. Participants enjoy a wonderful experience amid picturesque landscapes and coastal routes, with amenities including electronic timing, a medal, a commemorative T-shirt, and refreshment stations. The event is organized by Chios Cyclists and the Municipality of Oinousses, offering a friendly, summery sporting event.

name: 10α Παραποτάμια
description: The Pantavrechei Mountaineering Club is organizing the 10th consecutive year of the Riverside Races on August 2, 2026, in Prodromos, Evrytania. These mixed river- and trail-crossing races feature two distances, 8 and 14 kilometers, starting at Dipotama Proussou and finishing in Prodromos village square. The course includes sections through the water, trails with 350 meters of elevation gain, and two water stations. The event is co-organized with the Regional Unit of Evrytania and the Municipality of Karpenisi, under the auspices of the SEGAS Central Greece Athletics Association.

name: 13ος Αυξέντιος Δρόμος
location: Church of the Holy Spirit, Pirouniana, Heraklion, Crete, Greece
description: The 13th Afxentios Run is a 7.4-kilometer race held in the Pirouniana area of Heraklion, Crete. The start and finish are in the courtyard of the Church of the Holy Spirit. The circular route follows rural dirt roads and accessible trails, passing notable local landmarks such as the settlement of Pirouniana, the stone fountain, Agios Georgios Chostos (11th century), the waterfall, and the forest. The race is open to men, women, teenage boys, and teenage girls, offering an opportunity for physical activity in a natural and historic setting.

name: Parapotamia -Krikelopotamos o bregmenos dromos
description: The Parapotamia – Krikelopotamos, The Wet Road race is organized by the Panta Vrechei Greek Mountaineering Club in the South Evrytania region. This mountain race crosses rivers and trails, offering a unique experience in a natural setting rich in history and natural beauty. Founded in 2015, the club is active in the area and maintains trails and promotes mountain sports. Taking part in the race supports the continuation of the club’s activities and helps showcase the region.

name: 13οι Αυξέντιοι Αγώνες Κρήτης
location: Πιρουνιανά, Αγία Βαρβάρα, Heraklion, Crete, Greece

name: 2ο Olympia Night Run «Run Under Zeus»
description: The 2nd Olympia Night Run “Run Under Zeus” is a nighttime road race held in the heart of Ancient Olympia, honoring the tradition of the first Olympic Games. The race takes place under the light of the full moon, bringing to life the myth of Hercules and Zeus and offering a unique running experience in a historic and mythical setting. The event is supported by the Greek National Tourism Organization and aims to combine sport with a message of life and culture.

name: Voio Race Series
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations in the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, well-being, environmental and social responsibility, with the involvement of volunteers and the active participation of the local community. Sport is presented as the most beautiful part of life, while taking part is considered a victory and finishing a triumph. The event welcomes everyone and encourages young people and children to take part in creative and enjoyable activities.

name: Βαλτινές Διαδρομές
organizer: Σύλλογος Χαλκιποπουλιωτών Αθήνας – Πειραϊά «ΑΓΙΟΣ ΑΝΔΡΕΑΣ Ο ΕΡΗΜΙΤΗΣ»
description: The “Valtines Routes” road races are being held for the fourth consecutive year alongside the Inachos River, in Neos Chalkiopoulo, Valtos, Aetolia-Acarnania. The Association of Chalkiopoulo Residents of Athens–Piraeus “Saint Andrew the Hermit” invites you to take part in a celebration of culture and sport, held as part of the cultural events from August 10 to 17. The races include three routes, with electronic timing and support from volunteers and the local community.

name: 14ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Χίου
description: The 14th Chios Half Marathon is organized by the Chios Health Athletes Association in collaboration with the Municipality and the Chios Regional Unit. The race and its accompanying sports and cultural events will take place in the traditional settlement of Kampos, Chios, on August 23, 2026. Alongside the half marathon, there will also be 1.5 km (children’s), 5 km, and 10.5 km races, as well as races for people with disabilities. This celebration of sport and culture invites runners of all ages and abilities to take part.

name: Στη Σκιά του Κριάκουρα
description: The “In the Shadow of Kriakouras” mountain running race is being held for the 12th year in Theodoriana, Arta, offering two challenging courses of 10 and 23 kilometers. The routes pass through fir forests, rivers, and trails of exceptional natural beauty and difficulty, revealing the secrets of the Tzoumerka mountains. The race is dedicated to the person who inspired the first event in 2014 and serves as a qualifying race for participation in major mountain marathons. The start and finish are in Theodoriana’s central square, with all races starting at 10:00 a.m.

name: 45οι Δικταίοι Αγώνες
location: Psychro, Lasithi Plateau, Lasithi, Crete, Greece

name: Black Yard Ultra
description: BLACK YARD Ultra by Mamali Festival is a challenging ultra trail race that starts and finishes at the Mamali Festival Base Camp, at an elevation of approximately 1,454 meters. It includes a Last Runner Standing ultra race, a 12-kilometer race, and a 1-kilometer children’s race. The 12-kilometer loop has 514 meters of elevation gain, mostly on trails and dirt roads, and the ultra requires experience, as each lap becomes increasingly demanding with less time to complete it. The Base Camp offers camping facilities, showers, food, and a festival atmosphere, creating a unique experience for participants.

name: MAMALI BLACKYARD ULTRA
description: Mamali BlackYard Ultra 2026 is a Last Runner Standing-style endurance race held in the mountainous surroundings of Mamali, at an elevation of 1,454 meters, on August 29–30, 2026. Runners are challenged to complete continuous laps of the same course. A 12-kilometer trail race is also held for those looking for a quick mountain experience. There is also an untimed 1-kilometer children’s race, ideal for families. The event offers a fully organized Base Camp with free camping, coffee, refreshments, and a festival atmosphere throughout the race.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Αλληλεγγύης Ι.Ν. Αγίου Χαραλάμπους
7ος Νυχτερινός Αγώνας Δρόμου Γουμένισσας «Τρέχω Για Μένα»
Δρόμος Μάχης Μαραθώνα
description: The Battle of Marathon Road Race is a historic race organized by the Telmissos Marathon Runners Club. The race honors the memory of the Battle of Marathon and offers a unique running experience on a route of historical and natural beauty. Telmissos actively supports the race and invites runners of all levels to take part and run together in Marathon. The event includes accompanying races and group registrations, strengthening the spirit of community and sporting tradition.

name: Ορειβατικός Μαραθώνιος Ολύμπου
description: The Olympus Mountaineering Marathon is a historic race organized by the Thessaloniki Mountaineering Club. It is a demanding route across Mount Olympus, offering participants unique natural beauty and challenges. The event includes 5, 15, and 42-kilometer routes, catering to different levels of difficulty and experience. The organizers emphasize athlete safety and support, with aid stations along the course.

name: Voio Race Series
description: VoioRace is a series of four road races held in different locations across the Municipality of Voio, offering beautiful mountain routes for walking and running. The event aims to promote health, well-being, and social cohesion, with volunteers and the active participation of the local community. Sport is presented as a wonderful part of life, while taking part is considered a victory and finishing a triumph. The event is open to people over 15 and encourages young people and children to participate with their parents’ consent.

name: 20ό Hercules Series
description: The 20th Hercules Series is a series of mountain races held in Ypati, Phthiotis, offering routes of varying distances that cross the most iconic trails of Mount Oiti. The races feature demanding routes with natural beauty, historic sites, and picturesque villages, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with nature. The event is open to runners of all levels and offers a unique mountain-running experience in a magnificent setting.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: The Oiti Ultra Trail (OUT 100K) is a demanding 101.7-kilometer ultramarathon on Mount Oiti, with 5,265 meters of elevation gain. The route combines natural and historic trails, passing through mountain villages, dense forests, and Oiti’s highest peak. It offers a unique experience that pushes the limits of body and mind. The race connects sport with nature and history, making it a challenge for mountain-running enthusiasts.

name: 8ο Acheloos Run
description: The 8th Acheloos Run is organized by the Oiniades Running Team in Neochori, Messolonghi, and includes road races on public roads for all ages. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas beside the Acheloos River, with flat terrain and historic sites, offering a unique running experience. The finish is near the sea, where runners can enjoy local products and music at a beach party. The event is supported by volunteers and safety agencies to ensure participants’ safety.

name: Oiti Ultra Trail
description: The Oiti Ultra Trail is a challenging 101.7-kilometer ultramarathon held on Mount Oiti, combining natural beauty, history, and endurance. The route includes trails through dense forests, mountain settlements, and the highest peak of Oiti, offering runners a unique experience. The race is part of the events organized by the Fthiotida Runners Club TRACHINA and is classified as UTMB 100K with 4 ITRA points. The event connects sport with the region’s nature and history.

name: Serifos Sunset Race
description: The Serifos Sunset Race 2026 is a unique sporting event combining running and swimming races on the enchanting island of Serifos on the weekend of September 12–13, 2026. The courses include 5 km and 10 km running races starting and finishing at Vagia Beach, as well as 750 m, 1,500 m and 3,000 m swimming races in Livadi Bay. The event offers a unique sunset running experience, ideal for runners and swimmers of all levels. It also gives you the opportunity to visit beautiful Serifos and enjoy local activities and hospitality.

name: Syros Trail Challenge
description: Syros Trail Challenge 2026 is a running race held in Ermoupoli, Syros, featuring 3 km and 10 km routes. The routes pass through paved alleyways, stairs, trails, and stone-paved paths, offering a unique experience in an urban and natural setting. The race is open to men and women over 18, with age categories for the 10 km race, and includes a commemorative T-shirt and medal for all participants. The start and finish are at Miaouli Square in Ermoupoli, and the maximum time allowed to complete the races is 2 hours and 30 minutes.

name: 1ο Prostate Cancer Race «Τρέχουμε για την Πρόληψη»
11ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Μνήμης για τη Μικρασιατική Καταστροφή «Από τον Ασκάνιο στον Ερασίνο»
8ο Νάουσα Βέρμιο Trail
organizer: Α.Σ. Νάουσα Βέρμιο Trail και Δήμος Νάουσας
description: The Naousa Vermio Trail offers a unique mountain-running experience on Mount Vermio and in the city of Naousa. It features routes of varying distances, including the challenging 6 Peaks race (44 km, with 3,000 meters of elevation gain), the Amazonios (24.4 km), the Ververa (10 km), and the fun Alsos Fun & Run (6 km). The routes cross beautiful natural landscapes, peaks, and trails, offering a challenge for runners of all levels. The welcoming event supports participants with aid stations and course markings.

name: Patmos ChoRun
description: Patmos ChoRun 2026 is a road race held on Patmos on Sunday, September 13, 2026. It features a 21-kilometer race (half marathon), a 5-kilometer race, a 1,000-meter children’s race, and power walking. The races start from central locations in Chora, offering a beautiful running experience on the island’s public roads. The event is organized by the Patmos “Stadion” Gymnastics Club in cooperation with the Municipality of Patmos and the South Aegean Region, under the auspices of the Dodecanese Regional Athletics Association (EAS SEGAS).

name: Hercules Series
description: The Hercules Series is a mountain running race series held in Ypati and Mount Oiti on September 12 and 13, 2026. It includes four unique courses of varying distances and difficulty, as well as a children’s race in Loutra Ypatis. The courses feature challenging climbs and natural beauty, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and a connection with the mountains. The event is open to everyone and is organized by the Fthiotida Runners’ Association TRACHINA.

name: 1ος Διεθνής Ημιμαραθώνιος «Νικηταράς»
location: εκκίνηση: Άνω Δολιανά –  τερματισμός: Τρίπολη Αρκαδίας
description: The 1st International “Nikitaras 2026” Half Marathon is an outdoor road race held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli, as part of a three-day event in honor of Yiannis Kouros. The race starts in Ano Doliana and finishes in Tripoli, offering a unique experience for runners wishing to take part in an international half marathon. The event emphasizes safety and course quality, with a limited number of participants to ensure better organization and protect runners’ health.

name: 20ός Γύρος Λίμνης Ιωαννίνων
description: The Ioannina Lake Run is a flat, paved 30-kilometer race that passes through the area around Lake Pamvotida, offering a unique experience amid a landscape of natural beauty. It is suitable both for runners taking on this distance for the first time and for those aiming for strong performances. The start and finish are at Mavili Square in Ioannina, with runners setting off in waves from 8:15 a.m. The event has a long tradition and attracts thousands of runners each year, creating a three-day running festival with races for all ages and ability levels.

name: 1ος Διεθνής Διπλός Μαραθώνιος Δρόμος “Γιάννης Κούρος 2026”
organizer: Γιάννης Κούρος – Πέρα από τα όρια
description: The 1st International Double Marathon «Yiannis Kouros 2026» is a demanding ultramarathon of approximately 455 kilometers, starting and finishing in Tripoli. The race runs over varied terrain, mainly old paved roads with hills, as well as dirt roads and trails. Runners are encouraged to bring headlamps for the night course. The race has a completion time limit of 84 hours, and participation is by invitation, with strict performance criteria. The race is part of a three-day celebration honoring Yiannis Kouros and is held under the auspices of the Municipality of Tripoli.

name: 3ο Dadia Trail Run
description: The 3rd Dadia Trail Run is a mountain race held in the Dadia Forest, in Soufli, Evros, every September since 2024. The race is organized to help restore the natural environment and promote sports for all, inspired by the message that hope can rise again from the ashes. The event is supported by the Authentic Athens Marathon Runners’ Group «ORAMA» and the Honorary Chief of the Hellenic Army General Staff, retired General Charalambos Lalousis, who has a special connection to the area. The race invites everyone to take an active part in the effort to restore the forest and life.

name: 9ο Lesvos Trail
description: The 9th Lesvos Trail is a mountain running event held in Lepetymnos, Lesvos, offering 15 km, 6 km, and 1 km routes. The routes cross the Lepetymnos mountain range and pass through agricultural and livestock-farming areas, combining natural beauty with local character. The event is supported by the Molyvos Tourism Board and has been moved to an autumn date due to restrictions in the area. The race is ideal for runners seeking a mountain-running experience in a warm yet beautiful setting.

name: 10ο Lailias Mountain Running
description: The 10th Lailias Mountain Running race will be held on September 20, 2026, at the Lailias Ski Center near Serres. This mountain running event features two routes, 6Km and 21Km, giving runners the chance to enjoy the natural pine forest and the unexplored trails of Lailias. The race is suitable for both beginners and more experienced runners, with elevation gains of 200m and 1350m respectively, offering a unique mountain running experience in a beautiful setting.

name: Run Greece Trikala
description: Run Greece Trikala 2026 is a running event offering 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a power walking event and races for children and families. The event emphasizes runner safety and support, with support stations and medical coverage. Participation is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. Runners who complete the 10 km race receive a medal and a certificate of participation. The event offers an opportunity for physical activity and community participation in the city of Trikala.

name: Thessaloniki Stage Run
description: The Thessaloniki Stage Run is a multi-stage race in the peri-urban Seich Sou Forest in Thessaloniki, designed for runners of all levels. It consists of three race stages: a 15 km night race, a challenging 40 km race, and a fast 25 km race, offering a comprehensive trail-running experience. The event encourages participants to run all three stages to fully enjoy the journey through the forest. The race combines natural beauty, challenge, and atmosphere, with the city lights as a backdrop.

name: 2ο Folegandros Challenge Run
description: The Folegandros Challenge Run is a road race held on the island of Folegandros, offering distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km. The main event is the half marathon, with a course from Livadi to Chrysopigi and Pounta, featuring approximately 660 meters of elevation gain and the island’s characteristic hills. The 10 km race starts from Pounta Square and follows a loop course with gentle hills and beautiful views of the island. The event is organized by the Municipality of Folegandros in cooperation with the local running community, and the first edition received positive feedback for the quality of the course.

name: 44ο Σπάρταθλον
description: The Spartathlon is a historic and exceptionally demanding ultramarathon held from Athens to Sparta, retracing the steps of the ancient runner Pheidippides. The course covers approximately 246 kilometers over varied terrain, from flat sections to steep climbs and descents, with elevation changes of up to 1,200 meters. The race starts at 07:00 on the morning of September 26, 2026, and lasts up to 36 hours, with strict time limits at the checkpoints. It is intended for experienced, well-prepared runners who meet specific performance standards in previous ultramarathon races.

name: Ainos Mountain Marathon
description: The Ainos Mountain Marathon is a demanding mountain marathon held on Mount Ainos in Kefalonia. The 40.5-kilometer course crosses mountainous terrain on technical trails, with a total elevation gain of 2,500 meters, offering panoramic views of the surrounding islands and the mountains of Central Greece and the Peloponnese. There are also a half marathon of 23.5 km and an 11.1 km trail race, starting from the village of Pyrgi. The event provides bus transportation for athletes, free post-race food, and special offers on ferry tickets and accommodation.

name: Run Greece Alexandroupoli
description: Run Greece Alexandroupoli 2026 is a friendly road race offering 10 km and 5 km routes, children’s races, and a Family Run for the whole family. The event prioritizes safety and medical coverage, with volunteers and medical support along the course. Participation is open to everyone, with special rates for students in group registrations. The race is an opportunity for physical activity and community participation in the beautiful city of Alexandroupoli.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου «Στις γειτονιές των Μικρασιατών Προσφύγων»
27ος Λαϊκός Αγώνας Δρόμου Νεάπολης Αγρινίου
description: The 27th Neapoli Agrinio Popular Road Race is a traditional running event held in the beautiful area of Neapoli, Aetolia-Acarnania. The race covers a distance of approximately 10 kilometers and offers an enjoyable course for runners of all levels. The welcoming event aims to promote sports and the local community. Participants can expect a well-organized event focused on athlete safety and support.

name: MakrakomiBackyardUltra
description: Makrakomi Backyard Ultra is a demanding ultradistance Backyard Ultra race held in the beautiful area of Makrakomi, West Phthiotis. Participants are challenged to run a 6,706-meter loop every hour, with a new start for the remaining athletes, until one winner remains. The race promotes sport, culture, and environmental protection, offering a unique experience in a natural and sensitive environment. The start and finish are at Makrakomi’s central square, with the race starting at 09:00 in the morning.

name: 1ος Ημιμαραθώνιος Σαλαμίνα «Ahepa Run»
description: The 1st Salamina Half Marathon “Ahepa Run” is a new series of road races combining Greece’s history, culture, and sport. The routes pass through ancient paths and natural landscapes, offering a unique running experience that honors the country’s rich cultural heritage. The event is open to runners of all levels and promotes health, well-being, and social connection. Alongside the half marathon, 5-kilometer and 1-kilometer races for children are also held, as well as races for people with disabilities.

name: 4ο Γόμφοι Trail
description: The 4th Gomfoi Trail race, “Along the Paths of Our Ancestors,” will take place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, in the Gomfoi area of Trikala. This unique event features two semi-mountain routes, starting and finishing at Gomfoi’s central square and following trails, forest roads, and rural roads in the foothills of Mount Itamos and across the Thessalian plain. The race aims to showcase the area’s natural beauty and historical heritage, while promoting sports tourism and fair play.

name: 5ο Armeno Gate Trail Race
description: The 5th Armeno Gate Trail Race is a mountain race held in the Karystos area of Evia. It is a local event supported by the Armeno Gate Trail Organizing Committee, with Ultra Effort Coaching and Chalkida Sports Academy as co-organizers. The race offers an authentic trail-running experience, ideal for runners seeking routes in a natural setting. The event is supported by the Municipality of Karystos and the Regional Unit of Evia. October weather is usually cool and favorable for races.

name: Ημιμαραθώνιος Κρήτης
description: The Crete Half Marathon, organized by the Arkalohori Health Sports Club (ATHLI.S.Y.), is an important sporting event in the Arkalohori area of Heraklion. The race offers runners a unique opportunity to enjoy a route that combines natural beauty with sporting spirit, while also supporting the local community and young people through scholarship programs. The event aims to promote health and exercise in Crete, with an emphasis on the participants’ endurance and effort.

name: Spetses Mini Marathon
description: The Spetses Mini Marathon is Greece’s largest multi-sport event, held on the beautiful island of Spetses. It includes running and swimming races for all ages and levels, with a participation medal for everyone and awards by age category. The courses offer unique experiences with refreshment stations and beautiful scenery, while the organizers prioritize athletes’ comfort and safety. The event attracts runners and swimmers from around the world, offering a celebration of sport and culture.

name: Run Greece Piraeus
description: Run Greece Piraeus 2026 offers a unique road-running experience in the heart of Piraeus, with routes suitable for runners of all levels. It includes 10 km and 5 km races, a power walking event, a children’s race, and a family run. The event is welcoming to everyone, promoting sports and social participation in a beautiful urban setting. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with electronic timing and support throughout the race.

name: IRAKLEIOS ATHLOS
description: The IRAKLIOS ATHLOS is a mountain running race held on Mount Erymanthos, in the Micha-Tsapournia area of the Municipality of Erymanthos, Achaia. It features three routes: 21 km, 9 km, and a 2 km children’s race, with varied terrain including fir forest, an alpine zone, and forest dirt roads. The race combines athletic challenge with experiencing nature and environmental awareness, promoting the protection of the Erymanthos ecosystem. The organizers provide electronic timing, medical coverage, refreshments, medals, and technical T-shirts for participants in the longer routes.

name: Xeskouriazo Trail
description: The ΞεΣκουριάΖω mountain running race has been organized since 2013 by the Women’s Association of Megali Panagia on Mount Kakavos in Halkidiki. Dedicated to environmental protection and opposition to gold-copper mining, the race promotes trail running and showcases the area’s natural beauty. The routes start and finish at Chorostasi Square in Megali Panagia and offer a unique experience in mountainous terrain with significant elevation gain. The race welcomes athletes from all over Greece and aims to keep the mountains alive and protected.

name: 10ος Αγώνας Δρόμου Αλμυρού «Δίδυμες Μετεωρίτικες Λίμνες Ζερέλια»

description: The Aitoliko Lagoon Round is an established road race held every September and organized by the Aitoliko Runners’ Athletic and Cultural Association. The race takes place in the beautiful town of Aitoliko, known as Greece’s Little Venice. Its route circles the lagoon, offering unique natural beauty and a memorable sporting experience. Around 500 athletes and high-level runners from across Greece take part in the sporting events, along with many children running shorter routes. The event combines sport and culture, with activities held at Aitoliko’s East Beach, creating a celebration for participants and spectators alike.

name: B2Run Aθens
description: B2Run Athens 2026 is a corporate 5-kilometer running event held at the iconic Olympic Stadium of OAKA. More than 2,000 runners from various industries take part wearing their company colors, fostering team spirit and collaboration among colleagues. After the race, a lively after-run party follows, featuring live music, a DJ, food, and an awards ceremony, making B2Run a unique sports and entertainment experience for the corporate world.

name: Ορεινός Αγώνας Δρόμου «Περιβάλλον και Ενοπλες Δυνάμεις»
1ο Famagusta Run
description: The 1st Famagusta Run is an international road race held in the Protaras area of Cyprus, aiming to bring together athletes, families, and communities from Cyprus and abroad. The routes start and finish at Fig Tree Bay Beach, offering unique views of the Mediterranean Sea and the beauty of the area. The race promotes hope, peace, and sport, marking a new chapter in Cyprus’s sporting history. The event welcomes all participants, with categories for all ages and running levels.

name: Run The City – Latsia / Geri
description: The Municipality of Latsia-Geri Road Race, Run The City, is a major celebration of sport and solidarity held in the neighborhoods of the new Municipality of Latsia-Geri. The event is open to all ages and levels of runners, offering routes for children and experienced runners. With every step, participants support the Cyprus Anti-Cancer Society, while activities, music, and surprises are available for young and old alike. The event is hosted at the Latsia-Geri Town Hall and offers an opportunity for community service and athletic participation.

description: The 14th Thessaloniki International Night Half Marathon is a unique sporting event that combines athletics with the city’s nighttime party. Participants can enjoy a half-marathon course, as well as 10,000m, 5,000m, and 1-mile races, with full support and amenities. The event offers commemorative T-shirts, medals, electronic timing, and energy support, creating a welcoming and lively atmosphere for all runners. It also promotes social responsibility and culture, strengthening the Thessaloniki community.
